riddle_english: I need sharp eyesight and one eye closed. My weapon must hit the target so I can stay alive on the battlefield, because if I miss, I’ll become the next victim. What game am I playing?

riddle_original:
Aku memintamu menyerahkan kepemilikan satu-satunya peluru kepada musuh setelah kau memukulnya. Semakin kuat kau menghantamnya, semakin banyak waktu yang kau miliki 
untuk melarikan diri dari sasaran tembak mereka. Apa aku
riddle_english:
I’m asking you to hand over your only bullet to the enemy after you hit them. The harder you hit them, the more time you’ll have 
to escape their line of fire. Am I

riddle_original: Aku memberimu pelindung yang justru melemahkanmu. Semakin keras kau mencoba melangkah seperti biasa di dalamku, semakin cepat kau akan tersungkur mencium tanah. Apa aku?
riddle_english: I’ve given you a shield that actually weakens you. The harder you try to walk as usual inside me, the faster you’ll fall flat on your face. What am I?

riddle_original:
Aku adalah musuh yang bergerak melingkar, menciptakan ritme yang harus kau ikuti dengan patuh. Caraku mengalahkanmu bukan dengan mengejarmu, melainkan dengan membiarkanmu
melompati tubuhku berkali-kali hingga kau sendiri yang lelah dan menyerahkan kakimu untuk kuikat. Apa aku?
riddle_english:
I am an enemy that moves in circles, creating a rhythm you must follow obediently. I defeat you not by chasing you, but by letting you
jump over my body again and again until you grow tired and surrender your feet for me to bind. What am I?

riddle_original:
Aku adalah kompetisi di mana kau harus melangkah maju demi membuat lawanmu mundur. Namun ingat, jika kau terlalu bernafsu mendorong tanpa pijakan yang kokoh, bobot tubuhmu sendiri yang akan menjadi senjata lawan 
untuk merubuhkanmu. Apa aku?
riddle_english:
I am a competition where you must step forward to force your opponent to retreat. But remember, if you push too hard without a solid footing, your own body weight will become your 
opponent’s weapon to bring you down. What am I?

riddle_original:
Aku adalah pertempuran di mana menyentuh markas lawan adalah kemenangan mutlak, namun pertahanan terbaik justru dilakukan dengan cara membiarkan musuhmu mendekat hingga mereka kehilangan hak atas kebebasannya 
sendiri. Apa aku?
riddle_english:
I am a battle in which reaching the enemy’s base is an absolute victory, yet the best defense is achieved by letting your enemies get close enough that they lose their own freedom.
What am I?

riddle_original:
Aku memberimu kebebasan untuk melempar tinggi harapanmu, namun aku mengikatmu pada aturan ketat untuk menata kekacauan di bawahnya sebelum waktu yang kuberikan habis. 
Jika kau terlalu serakah meraup semuanya sekaligus, kau justru akan kehilangan kendali atas segalanya. Apa aku?
riddle_english:
I give you the freedom to set your hopes high, but I bind you to strict rules to bring order to the chaos beneath before the time I’ve given you runs out. 
If you’re too greedy and try to grab everything at once, you’ll actually lose control of it all. Who am I?

riddle_original: Jemarimu bisa memutar dan menarikku kapan saja, tapi seumur hidup matamu takkan pernah bisa membuktikan keberadaanku secara langsung. Aku adalah penerima pesan yang bersembunyi dari cahaya pandanganmu. Apakah aku?
riddle_english: Your fingers can twist and pull me at any time, but your eyes will never be able to directly confirm my existence. I am the message-bearer hiding from the light of your gaze. Who am I?

riddle_original: Aku ada di pinggir api, dan ada juga di tengah air, apakah aku?
riddle_english: I am at the edge of the fire, and I am also in the middle of the water—what am I?

riddle_original: Masuknya miring, keluarnya juga miring, apa itu?
riddle_english: It goes in at an angle, and it comes out at an angle too what is that?

riddle_original: Pintu apa yang kalau dibuka dapat membahayakan banyak orang?
riddle_english: What kind of door, if opened, could endanger many people?

riddle_original: Bunga apa yang panas?
riddle_english: What flower is hot?

riddle_original: Binatang apa yang jalannya lurus terus, tidak bisa belok?
riddle_english: What animal walks in a straight line and can’t turn?

riddle_original: Perang apa yang membutuhkan selimut?
riddle_english: What kind of war requires blankets?

riddle_original: Bulan apa yang tidak tercantum di kalender?
riddle_english: Which month is not listed on the calendar?

riddle_original: Dokter apa yang tidak boleh jatuh cinta sama pasiennya?
riddle_english: What kind of doctor shouldn’t fall in love with a patient?

riddle_original: Binatang apa yang kalau di obati malah mati
riddle_english: What kind of animal dies even when treated?

riddle_original: Ikan apa yang matanya banyak?
riddle_english: Which fish has many eyes?

riddle_original: Sayuran apa yang dilarang pemerintah?
riddle_english: Which vegetable is banned by the government?

riddle_original: Sayuran apa yang hobi tunjuk orang lain?
riddle_english: What vegetable likes pointing at other people?

riddle_original: Burung apa yang hobi ke toilet?
riddle_english: What bird loves going to the toilet?

riddle_original: Hewan apa yang penting buat tubuh?
riddle_english: What animal is important for the body?

riddle_original: Hewan apa yang taat lalu lintas?
riddle_english: What animal obeys traffic rules?

riddle_original: Hewan apa yang paling bikin damai?
riddle_english: What animal brings the most peace?

riddle_original: Hewan apa yang paling sederhana?
riddle_english: What animal is the simplest?

riddle_original: Ayam apa yang paling besar?
riddle_english: Which chicken is the biggest?

riddle_original: Burung apa yang bikin merinding?
riddle_english: What bird gives you goosebumps?

riddle_original: Hitam, putih, merah, apakah itu?
riddle_english: Black, white, and red; what is it?

riddle_original: Telor apa yang sangar?
riddle_english: What egg looks fierce?
reference_answer_english: Salted egg, because it has tattoos

riddle_original: Kalau hitam dibilang bersih, kalau putih dibilang kotor?
riddle_english: If it’s black it’s called clean, if it’s white it’s called dirty?

riddle_original: Uang kalau dilempar jadi apa?
riddle_english: What does money become when thrown?

riddle_original: Benda apa yang baru dibeli langsung dibuang?
riddle_english: What thing gets thrown away right after being bought?

riddle_original: Kenapa di komputer ada tulisan enter?
riddle_english: Why is there an “Enter” key on a computer?
reference_answer_original: Karena kalo tulisannya entar, programnya ngga jalan-jalan
reference_answer_english: Because if it said “later” instead of “Enter,” the program would never start

riddle_original: Kenapa Sinterklas ketawanya hohoho?
riddle_english: Why does Santa Claus laugh “ho ho ho”?
reference_answer_english: Because if he laughed “hee hee hee,” he’d be a ghost instead

riddle_original: Benda kecil apa yang bisa ngeluarin orang?
riddle_english: What small object can make people leave?

riddle_original: Kutu jenis yang amat mengerikan?
riddle_english: What kind of flea is the most terrifying?

riddle_original: Kenapa di rel kereta api ditaruh batu?
riddle_english: Why are there stones placed on railroad tracks?
reference_answer_original: Soalnya kalau ditaruh duit nanti pada diambil
reference_answer_english: Because if they put money there, people would take it

riddle_original: Con grande scandalo, per primo fu trovato senza mani pulite.
riddle_english: With great scandal, he was the first to be found without clean hands

riddle_original: Aveva le mani così sporche... che fuggì in nord Africa.
riddle_english: His hands were so dirty... that he fled to North Africa

riddle_original: Fino a tempi recenti, quelli che appena appena potevano guidare, per questo organo non potevano votare.
riddle_english: Until recently, those who could just about drive, could not vote for this body.

riddle_original: Ricopro per sempre una carica di grande onore, per aver servito la patria, e per i miei successi nelle scienze oppure nelle arti.
riddle_english: I hold for life a position of great honour, having served my country, and for my achievements in the sciences or the arts.

riddle_original: Il partito che sembra un grido... da stadio.
riddle_english: The party that sounds like a chant... from a stadium.

riddle_original: Due amici, una toga e un solo destino contro il male che stava loro vicino.
riddle_english: Two friends, one robe and one shared fate against the evil that lived right beside them.

riddle_original: Siedo in alto dove l'aria è più pura, guardo il gioco senza muovere i pezzi, ma sono io a firmare l'ultimo atto.
riddle_english: I sit high where the air is purer, I watch the game without moving the pieces, but I am the one who signs the final act.

riddle_original: Non sono una persona, ma gestisco i tuoi viaggi e le divise di chi ti ferma per strada. Se dico che l'ordine è tornato, l'Italia sospira.
riddle_english: I am not a person, but I manage your travels and the uniforms of those who stop you on the street. If I say order has returned, Italy sighs.

riddle_original: Non sono una nave, ma sono il corridoio più famoso d'Italia, dove i parlamentari si scambiano segreti e i giornalisti cercano lo scoop.
riddle_english: I am not a ship, but I am the most famous corridor in Italy, where members of parliament exchange secrets and journalists look for a scoop.

riddle_original: Per decenni sono stata la creatura enorme e inaffondabile che ha dominato il centro, senza mai virare né a destra né a sinistra.
riddle_english: For decades I was the enormous and unsinkable creature that dominated the center, never turning right or left.

riddle_original: Fu ferito ad un arto inferiore... a suon di musica.
riddle_english: Was wounded in a lower limb... to the sound of music

riddle_original: Da galantuomo è passato alla storia, guidando il suo piccolo regno verso la gloria.
riddle_english: He went down in history as a gentleman, leading his small kingdom to glory.

riddle_original: Gli si chiede di portarci via quando ci sentiamo morire, in una canzone popolare.
riddle_english: We ask him to take us away when we feel like dying, in a popular tune.

riddle_original: Dell’Italia fu un grande sognatore, la voleva giovine e senza un signore.
riddle_english: Of Italy he was a great dreamer, he wanted her young and without a lord.

riddle_original: Furono piantate a Brescia, Bologna e in una piazza in centro a Milano.
riddle_english: They were planted in Brescia, Bologna and in a square in the centre of Milan.

riddle_original: Di intrighi e patti fu un gran tessitore, e della patria unita fu l’autore.
riddle_english: Of intrigues and pacts he was a great weaver, and of the united homeland he was the author.

riddle_original: Davanti a sé aveva un fiumiciattolo, e lo attraversò grazie a un dado.
riddle_english: Before him lay a small stream, and he crossed it by means of a die.

riddle_original: Bello di certo non era, ma di certo magnifico fu.
riddle_english: Handsome he certainly was not, but magnificent he certainly was.

riddle_original: Non usò le armi, ma solo la penna: in una prigione descrisse il suo dolore svegliando così negli italiani un gran fervore.
riddle_english: He used no weapons, only his pen: in a prison he described his suffering, thus awakening in Italians a great fervour.

riddle_original: Più di cent'anni visse con grazia e vigore, e nella mente cercò il segreto profondo per dare speranza a tutto il mondo.
riddle_english: She lived more than a hundred years with grace and vigour, and in the mind she sought the deep secret to give hope to the whole world.

riddle_original: La città sulla punta del piede.
riddle_english: The city on the tip of the toe.

riddle_original: Una catena che unisce il bianco e il rosa.
riddle_english: A chain connecting the white one and the pink one.

riddle_original: Sono 5 a picco sul mare.
riddle_english: They are 5 perched on the sea.

riddle_original: Pur non essendo il maggiore, è il più grande.
riddle_english: Although it is not 'the greater', it is the greatest.

riddle_original: È superba, ma in lei trovi sempre un porto sicuro.
riddle_english: She is proud, but in her you will always find a safe harbour.

riddle_original: È un monte e perciò non si può berne neppure un goccio.
riddle_english: It is a mountain, and therefore you cannot drink even a drop of it.

riddle_original: È biondo e bellissimo, ma è meglio non farsi il bagno con lui.
riddle_english: He is blond and very handsome, but it is better not to bathe with him.

riddle_original: Ho tre punte ma non pungo, e il mio cuore a volte sputa fuoco verso il mare.
riddle_english: I have three points but I don't prick, and my heart sometimes spits fire towards the sea.

riddle_original: I Greci mi chiamavano Ichnusa perché sembravo l'impronta di un piede nudo nel mezzo del Mediterraneo.
riddle_english: The Greeks called me Ichnusa because I looked like the footprint of a bare foot in the middle of the Mediterranean.

riddle_original: Un tempo vie di trasporto per il marmo del Duomo, oggi sono il palcoscenico della movida meneghina, dove l'acqua scorre lenta tra un aperitivo e l'altro.
riddle_english: Once transport routes for the Cathedral's marble, today they are the stage for the Milanese nightlife, where water flows slowly between one aperitivo and another.

riddle_original: Raggiunta una certa età, si ritrova in un bosco scarsamente illuminato.
riddle_english: Once he's reached a certain age, he finds himself in poorly-lit woods.

riddle_original: Si apre descrivendo qualcosa che tipicamente si estende dagli alberi, ma in questo caso appartiene a una grande massa d'acqua dolce.
riddle_english: It begins describing something that typically extends from trees, but in this case belongs to a large body of freshwater.

riddle_original: In che direzione è la fiera che vende animali a due soldi?
riddle_english: In which direction is the street market that sells animals for two pennies?

riddle_original: Dove uno potrebbe ritrovare il senno perso, secondo una famosa opera letteraria.
riddle_english: Where one may find their lost sanity, according to a famous literary work.

riddle_original: Naufragò in un mare pur avendo i piedi per terra.
riddle_english: He foundered in a sea, despite having his feet firmly on the ground.

riddle_original: Nasce, bellissima, da una conchiglia.
riddle_english: She is born, beautiful, from a shell.

riddle_original: Nei Novanta cantò mandando tutti a quel paese (ma molto più volgarmente).
riddle_english: In the 90s he sang and told everyone where to go (but much more vulgarly).

riddle_original: La sua storia vera fu che scivolò in un corso d'acqua a fine marzo, aprile, maggio o forse inizio giugno.
riddle_english: Her true story was that she slipped into a watercourse at the end of March, April, May, or perhaps early June.

riddle_original: Tra memorie e un po’ di follia, rese il cinema una pura magia.
riddle_english: Between memories and a touch of madness, he made cinema pure magic.

riddle_original: Siamo due guerrieri emersi dal sale, rimasti nudi per millenni. Abbiamo atteso a lungo in fondo al mare prima di ritrovare la terra ferma sulla punta dello stivale.
riddle_english: We are two warriors who emerged from salt, having remained naked for millennia. We waited a long time at the bottom of the sea before finding land again on the tip of the boot.

riddle_original: Si implica spesso che la moglie lo tradisca... durante la partita.
riddle_english: It is often implied that his wife is cheating on him... during the match

riddle_original: Il mezzo di trasporto preferito di quelli che indossano magliette color rosa o ciclamino.
riddle_english: The favourite means of transport of those who wear a pink or cyclamen t-shirt.

riddle_original: Una corsa in cui il cavallo può vincere anche senza il suo cavaliere, e dove l'orgoglio di un rione vale più della vita.
riddle_english: A race in which the horse can win even without its rider, and where a district's pride is worth more than life.

riddle_original: È il sogno di ogni ciclista italiano, un colore che non ha nulla a che fare con il sangue o il cielo, ma che corona il re delle tre settimane.
riddle_english: It is every italian cyclist's dream, a color that has nothing to do with blood or the sky, but crowns the king of the three weeks.

riddle_original: Sono chiamato "tempio", ma non ospito santi. Qui il silenzio è interrotto solo dal ruggito di motori che cercano l'eternità tra i boschi.
riddle_english: I am called a "temple", but I do not house saints. Here the silence is interrupted only by the roar of engines seeking eternity among the woods.

riddle_original: A Firenze si combatte per l'onore in una piazza, dove il confine tra gioco e rissa scompare per un giorno.
riddle_english: In Florence, one fights for honor in a square, where the line between a game and a brawl vanishes for a day.

riddle_original: Non è un trofeo da esporre in vetrina, ma un fregio che si porta sul cuore per un'intera stagione.
riddle_english: It is not a trophy to be displayed in a showcase, but a badge worn over the heart for an entire season.

riddle_original: È l'onore di chi arriva ultimo, un premio al contrario che un tempo spingeva i ciclisti a nascondersi nei bar o nei fossi per perdere tempo prezioso.
riddle_english: It is the honor of the one who finishes last, a reverse prize that once drove cyclists to hide in bars or ditches to waste precious time.

riddle_original: Per cinquant'anni è stato il rito della domenica pomeriggio, dove tre segni e un numero magico potevano trasformare un operaio in un milionario.
riddle_english: For fifty years it was the Sunday afternoon ritual, where three symbols and a magic number could turn a worker into a millionaire.

riddle_original: Una freccia rossa che unisce il nord e la capitale, un museo in movimento che profuma di benzina e di strade d'altri tempi, definita la corsa più bella del mondo.
riddle_english: A red arrow that connects the North and the capital, a moving museum that smells of gasoline and old-fashioned roads, defined as the most beautiful race in the world.

riddle_original: Piccolo e coperto di zucchero... ma di nome l'opposto.
riddle_english: Small and covered in sugar... but in name, the opposite

riddle_original: Si balla quando si vien morsi da un animale a otto zampe.
riddle_english: It is danced after being bitten by an eight-legged animal.

riddle_original: Capì che ogni bambino è un piccolo fiore, che cresce se curato con mente e con cuore.
riddle_english: he understood that every child is a little flower, who grows if cared for with mind and with heart.
riddle_hint: (più storia che national heritage forse, ma potemmo spostarla dopo)

riddle_original: Nonostante il nome si mangiano, non si parlano, durante la festa delle maschere e travestimenti.
riddle_english: Despite their name, they're something you eat, not something you say, during the festival of masks and costumes.

riddle_original: Senza malta restano in piedi, con un cappello di pietra che guarda il cielo del tacco.
riddle_english: Without mortar they stay standing, with a stone hat gazing at the sky of the heel.

riddle_original: Un tempo definita "vergogna nazionale" per la sua povertà, oggi è una città millenaria scavata nel tufo.
riddle_english: Once defined as a "national shame" due to its poverty, today it is a thousand-year-old city carved into tuff.

riddle_original: È nera per legge e asimmetrica per natura; scivola sull'acqua guidata da un solo remo e da un pettine di ferro a sei denti.
riddle_english: It is black by law and asymmetrical by nature; it glides on the water guided by a single oar and a six-toothed iron comb.

riddle_original: Spesso sbeffeggiato dai romani come "macchina da scrivere" o "torta nuziale", protegge nel suo marmo bianco il milite che non ha nome.
riddle_english: Often mocked by Romans as a "typewriter" or "wedding cake", it protects within its white marble the soldier who has no name.

riddle_original: In Sicilia porto in scena le gesta di Carlo Magno e dei suoi paladini. Sono fatto di legno, metallo e fili, e le mie battaglie contro i saraceni sono patrimonio dell'umanità.
riddle_english: In Sicily, I stage the deeds of Charlemagne and his paladins. I am made of wood, metal, and strings, and my battles against the Saracens are world heritage.

riddle_original: A Roma mi chiamano con un accrescitivo affettuoso. Sono la cupola più famosa del mondo e il mio "padre" artistico mi ha voluto così grande da dominare ogni altro tetto della città eterna.
riddle_english: In Rome, they call me by an affectionate augmentative name. I am the most famous dome in the world, and my artistic 'father' wanted me large enough to dominate every other roof in the eternal City.

riddle_original: Stranamente, in questa attività, un canide aggressivo dei boschi si nutre esclusivamente di vegetali.
riddle_english: Curiously, in this activity, an aggressive woodland canid eats only plants.

riddle_original: L'attività che prende il nome da un insetto che non ci vede bene.
riddle_english: The activity named after an insect that can't see well.
reference_answer_english: Mosca cieca (Italian version of blind man's buff)

riddle_original: Tracciata col gesso, mi percorri a balzi e a un piede solo, cercando di non toccare i bordi per arrivare in paradiso.
riddle_english: Drawn with chalk, you traverse me in leaps and on one foot, trying not to touch the edges to reach paradise.

riddle_original: Sono un topolino dalle grandi orecchie e la voce fievole. Chiedo sempre un bacio della buonanotte e mi stupisco esclamando: "Ma cosa mi dici mai!".
riddle_english: I am a little mouse with big ears and a thin voice. I always ask for a goodnight kiss and express my surprise by saying: "But what are you ever telling me!".

riddle_original: In questa sfida televisiva i piccoli solisti cantano di quarantaquattro felini e caffè imbevibili, sognando di conquistare un'antica moneta di metallo prezioso.
riddle_english: In this television competition, young soloists sing about forty-four felines and undrinkable coffee, dreaming of winning an ancient coin made of precious metal.

riddle_original: Sono una cagnolina bianca coperta di grossi bolli rossi. Chiacchiero con gli oggetti e le nuvole, e il mio padrone ha un paio di baffi enormi e si chiama Armando.
riddle_english: I am a little white dog covered in big red spots. I chat with objects and clouds, and my owner has a pair of huge mustaches and is named Armando.

riddle_original: Sono il "cattivo" più pasticcione del Fantabosco. Indosso un gilet, vado matto per le pigne e cerco sempre di ingannare Tonio o Milo senza mai riuscirci davvero.
riddle_english: I am the clumsiest "villain" of the Fantabosco. I wear a vest, I am crazy for pine cones, and I always try to trick Tonio or Milo without ever really succeeding.

riddle_original: Abito in un tronco cavo all'interno di una corte colorata. Sono un uccello di pezza bianco e a pois che ha insegnato a generazioni di bambini a usare forbici e colla nei pomeriggi della Rai.
riddle_english: I live in a hollow trunk inside a colorful courtyard. I am a white polka-dot rag bird who taught generations of children how to use scissors and glue during Rai afternoon shows.

riddle_original: In questo gioco di gruppo, qualcuno decide una tonalità e tutti devono correre a toccare un oggetto di quel tipo per mettersi in salvo prima di essere catturati.
riddle_english: In this group game, someone calls out a color and everyone must run to touch an object of that color to be safe before getting caught.

riddle_original: Sono una merendina a forma di spirale che ha segnato un'epoca. La mia pubblicità diceva che la morale è sempre quella, mentre un goloso nativo americano cercava di rubarmi.
riddle_english: I am a spiral-shaped snack that defined an era. My advertisement said the moral is always the same, while a gluttonous Native American tried to steal me.

riddle_original: Suona come un delizioso barbecue nel bel mezzo dell'autostrada, ma al massimo ci ricavi un paninetto.
riddle_english: It sounds like a delicious BBQ in the middle of the motorway, but at most you'll come out of it with a small sandwich

riddle_original: Può essere solo rossa, bianca, o argento, e serve per spostarsi.
riddle_english: It can only be red, white, or silver, and it is for travelling

riddle_original: Copricapo da laureando... o personaggio Classico.
riddle_english: Headgear for a graduate... or a Classical figure.

riddle_original: Molti sbagliano, ma si mescola energicamente soltanto alla fine per rilasciare il suo collante naturale.
riddle_english: Many get it wrong, but it should only be stirred vigorously at the end to release its natural glue.

riddle_original: Quanti salti dal freezer alla padella?
riddle_english: How many hops from the freezer to the pan?

riddle_original: Occupo spazi dove non servirei: dal bracciolo del divano alla sommità della TV. Sono un ricamo di pizzo che non serve a nulla, se non a proteggere il legno e a testimoniare la pazienza della nonna.
riddle_english: I occupy spaces where I wouldn't be needed: from the armrest of the sofa to the top of the TV. I am a lace embroidery that serves no purpose, other than protecting the wood and witnessing grandma's patience.

riddle_original: Appaio nel conto finale senza essere stato ordinato; sono il prezzo di un servizio silenzioso e di quel cestino di pane che arriva in tavola prima ancora che tu possa aprire il menu.
riddle_english: I appear on the final bill without having been ordered; I am the price of a silent service and that basket of bread that arrives at the table even before you can open the menu.

riddle_original: Ho un corpo di metallo e borbotto in cucina finché il nero non sale. Sono l'unico orologio che sveglia la casa non con il suono, ma con l'aroma.
riddle_english: I have a metal body and I gurgle in the kitchen until the black rises. I am the only clock that wakes the house not with sound, but with aroma.

riddle_original: Non si infila ai piedi, ed è il modo più sincero per fare i complimenti al cuoco.
riddle_english: It doesn't go on your feet, but it's the most sincere way to compliment the chef.

riddle_original: Sono l'appuntamento delle sei, tra un bicchiere arancione e qualche stuzzichino, mentre il sole inizia a calare.
riddle_english: I am the six o'clock appointment, between an orange glass and some snacks, as the sun begins to set.

riddle_original: Due gemelli... cresciuti a quattro zampe.
riddle_english: Two twins... raised on four legs

riddle_original: Fuggì alla fine della guerra, mentre la città assediata veniva distrutta, portando in spalla il padre e tenendo per mano il figlio.
riddle_english: He fled at the end of the war, while the besieged city was being destroyed, with his father on his shoulders and his son hand in hand.

riddle_original: Non viene mai di giorno, e porta calzature in cattivo stato.
riddle_english: Never comes by day, and wears shoes in poor condition.

riddle_original: Parlava con creature senza la parola, e da queste veniva ascoltato.
riddle_english: He spoke with creatures without speech, and was listened to by them.

riddle_original: Il protettore più comune nelle case degli anziani, forse perché gli vengono attribuiti innumerevoli miracoli.
riddle_english: The most common protector in the homes of the elderly, perhaps because countless miracles are attributed to him.

riddle_original: Attento ai miei occhi: non uccidono, ma ti fanno impazzire. Non ho serpi in testa come lei, ma il mio corpo è coperto di scaglie.
riddle_english: Beware my eyes: they do not kill, but they will drive you mad. I have no serpents on my head like she does, but my body is covered in scales. Upon my head I wear a crown.

riddle_original: Un piccolo ospite in abiti da monaco che abita le case di Napoli senza invito. Se ti è amico trovi soldi nel cassetto, altrimenti ti nasconde pure le scarpe.
riddle_english: A small guest in a monk's habit who dwells in Neapolitan houses uninvited. If he is your friend you find money in the drawer; otherwise, he will even hide your shoes.

riddle_original: Un'arcata altissima costruita in una notte grazie a un patto col maligno. Il prezzo doveva essere un'anima umana, ma lo sfortunato a passare fu un cane.
riddle_english: A very high arch built in a single night thanks to a pact with the devil. The price was to be a human soul, but the unfortunate one to cross was a dog.

riddle_original: Il poeta mi nascose in una gabbia di ferro dentro un castello sul mare: finché resto intero, Partenope non cadrà mai.
riddle_english: The poet hid me in an iron cage inside a castle on the sea: as long as I remain intact, Partenope will never fall.

riddle_original: Amava così tanto il mare da non volerne più uscire. Ora sta negli abissi siciliani a reggere una delle tre colonne che sorreggono il mondo sopra di lui.
riddle_english: He loved the sea so much he never wanted to leave it. Now he stays in the Sicilian depths, holding up one of the three pillars that support the world above him.

riddle_original: Si dice siano mille qui da noi, imponenti in altezza e tutti sincronizzati tra loro.
riddle_english: They are said to be one thousand over here, imposingly tall and all in sync with each other.

riddle_original: Combinazione di sapori che non va assolutamente detta a colui che zappa la terra.
riddle_english: A combination of flavours that must never be spoken of to the one who works the land.

riddle_original: Lo sono le mani... di chi spende sempre troppo.
riddle_english: So are the hands... of those who always spend too much.

riddle_original: Quando guardi nel portafoglio ed è vuoto, che colore vedi?
riddle_english: When you look in your wallet and it's empty, what colour do you see?

riddle_original: Se ce l'hai vivo addosso, sei vivace e pieno di energie.
riddle_english: If you've got it alive on you, you're lively and full of energy.

riddle_original: Questo cibo piace così tanto alla gatta che a furia di ritornarci, prima o poi ci lascerà l'impronta.
riddle_english: The cat likes this food so much that, by dint of returning to it, sooner or later she'll leave her print on it.

riddle_original: Si augura a chi ha una sfida importante, sperando che finisca dritto tra i denti di un predatore dei boschi.
riddle_english: It is wished upon those facing an important challenge, hoping they end up straight between the teeth of a woodland predator.

riddle_original: Devi tenerla tra le labbra se vuoi che un segreto non scappi via, ma guai a deglutire.
riddle_english: You must hold it between your lips if you want a secret not to escape, but heaven forbid you swallow.

riddle_original: È quell'immensa distesa d'acqua che separa chi chiacchiera da chi realizza le cose.
riddle_english: It is that immense expanse of water that separates the one who chatters from the one who gets things done.

riddle_original: Indica l'abbondanza che arriva a chi non ne ha bisogno, come se il cielo decidesse di versare acqua solo su chi è già completamente fradicio.
riddle_english: It indicates abundance arriving for someone who doesn't need it, as if the sky decided to pour water only on those who are already completely soaked.
reference_answer_english: It rains on the wet one

riddle_original: ഏറ്റവും വലിയ ആൽ?
riddle_english: The biggest banyan (aal) tree?
riddle_hint: A word about governance or political life.
riddle_note: Kerala-specific: political strikes are a fixture of Kerala politics. Pun on 'aal' = banyan.

riddle_original: ഒരിക്കലും കായ്ക്കാത്ത മരം?
riddle_english: The tree that never bears fruit?
riddle_hint: A word about governance or political life.
riddle_note: Wordplay: -aram suffix. Protests don't bear 'fruit'; political commentary encoded as a riddle.

riddle_original: ആരും ആഗ്രഹിക്കാത്ത പണം?
riddle_english: The money nobody wants?
riddle_hint: A word about governance or political life.
riddle_note: Pun: '-panam' = money. Accusations are unwanted 'wealth'.

riddle_original: ഓരോ അഞ്ച് വർഷത്തിലും എന്താണ് സ്വിംഗ്, എന്നാൽ ഒരു പെൻഡുലം ക്ലോക്ക് അല്ലേ?
riddle_english: What swings every five years but isn’t a pendulum clock?
riddle_hint: A word about political ruling in Kerala
riddle_note: Related to unstable political relations where power keeps switching between LDF and UDF

riddle_original: കേരളത്തിൽ വിരിയാൻ പ്രയാസമുള്ള പൂവ് ഏതാണ്?
riddle_english: Which flower finds it hard to bloom in Kerala?
riddle_hint: A word about political ruling in Kerala
riddle_note: Related to BJPs unsuccessful campaigns in Kerala, the lotus refers to the party's symbol

riddle_original: മുഖമില്ലാത്ത ഒരു 'മുന്നണി'യാണ് ഞാൻ, ഞാൻ ശരിയാണെങ്കിലും എപ്പോഴും 'ഇടത്' തന്നെയാണ്.
riddle_english: I am a faceless 'front', always 'left' even if I am right.

riddle_original: എനിക്ക് 'കൈ' ഉണ്ട്, പക്ഷേ കൊട്ടാൻ കഴിയില്ല. എനിക്ക് ഒരുപാട് നേതാക്കളുണ്ട്, പക്ഷേ ഞാൻ എപ്പോഴും തിരയുന്നത് 'ഹൈക്കമാൻഡിനെ' ആണ്.
riddle_english: I have the 'hand' but can't clap. I have many leaders, but I always look for 'High Command'.

riddle_original: എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ ഒരു ചൂലുണ്ട്, പക്ഷെ ഞാൻ വീട് അടിച്ചുവാരാറില്ല.
riddle_english: I have a broom in my hand, but I don’t sweep the house.
riddle_note: This party isn't very dominant in Kerala

riddle_original: ഞാൻ ജനിച്ചത് കേരളത്തിൽ അല്ല, പക്ഷേ ജയിക്കാൻ ഞാൻ വയനാട്ടിലെ മലനിരകൾ കടന്ന് വരും.
riddle_english: I wasn't born in Kerala, but to win, I come crossing the hills of Wayanad.
riddle_hint: A political figure with influence in Kerala
riddle_note: This is related to how leaders born outside of Kerala come to the state to competer during National Elections.

riddle_original: ഞാനൊരു ചക്കയാണ്, പക്ഷേ ആർക്കും എന്നെ വെട്ടി തിന്നാൻ കഴിയില്ല, ഇരുപത് എൻ്റെ പ്രിയപ്പെട്ട നമ്പർ.
riddle_english: I am a jackfruit, but no one can cut and eat me, and twenty is my favourite number.

riddle_original: തൻ്റെ പേരിനൊപ്പം ജീവിച്ച, ശക്തിയോടെ ഭരിക്കുന്ന ഒരു രാജാവ്. ഞാൻ ആരായിരുന്നു?
riddle_english: A king who lived up to his name and ruled with strength. Who was I?
riddle_hint: A name of a Kerala king of past
riddle_note: His name has the malayalam word for "strength" in it

riddle_original: അൻപത് വർഷമായി ഞാൻ സ്വർണ്ണ തിടമ്പ് ധരിച്ചു, ഇപ്പോഴും ക്ഷേത്ര കവാടത്തിൽ കല്ലിൽ നിൽക്കുന്ന 'ഗജകേസരി' ഞാനാണ്. ഞാൻ ആരാണ്?
riddle_english: I wore the Golden Thidambu for fifty years, I am the 'Gajakesari' who still stands in stone at the temple gate. Who am I?
riddle_hint: A name of a famous elephant in Kerala

riddle_original:
ഞാൻ കേരളത്തിന്റെ രാജാവല്ല, എന്നാൽ രാജാക്കന്മാർ എന്നെ ഭയന്നു.
ഞാൻ പോർച്ചുഗീസുകാരെ കടലിൽ തോൽപ്പിച്ചു.
ഞാൻ ആരാണ്?
riddle_english: I am not the king of Kerala, but the kings feared me. I defeated the Portuguese at sea. Who am I?
riddle_hint: A name of a Kerala king of past

riddle_original:
എനിക്ക് ഒരു കൊട്ടാരമില്ല, എന്നാൽ ഞാൻ ഒരു സാമ്രാജ്യം ഭരിച്ചു.
ഞാൻ ആദ്യം ഒരു അദ്ധ്യാപകൻ, പിന്നെ ഒരു ചക്രവർത്തി.
ഞാൻ ആരാണ്?
riddle_english:
I don't have a palace, but I have ruled an empire.
I was first a teacher, then an emperor.
Who am I?
riddle_hint: A name of a Indian king of past

riddle_original:
ഞാൻ ഒരു നദിക്കരയിൽ ജനിച്ചു, ഒരു മരത്തിനടിയിൽ ജ്ഞാനം നേടി.
ഒരു രാജ്യം ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു, ഒരു ലോകത്തെ മാറ്റി.
ഞാൻ ആരാണ്?
riddle_english:
I was born on the banks of a river, gained wisdom under a tree.
I left a kingdom, changed a world.
Who am I?
riddle_hint: A king who started a religion

riddle_original:
കേരളത്തിൽ ഒരിക്കൽ ഒരു രാജ്യം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു, അതിന്റെ രാജാവ് ഓണത്തിന് ഒരിക്കൽ മടങ്ങിവരുന്നു.
ആ രാജാവ് ആരാണ്?
riddle_english:
Once upon a time there was a kingdom in Kerala, whose king would return once for Onam.
Who was that king?
riddle_hint: A revered king with a dedicated festival in Kerala

riddle_original: കൊളച്ചൽ യുദ്ധത്തിൽ ഡച്ചുകാരെ തോൽപ്പിക്കുകയും എന്റെ രാജ്യം ഭഗവാന് സമർപ്പിച്ച് അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ ദാസനായി  ഭരിക്കുകയും ചെയ്തത് ഞാനാണ്.
riddle_english: It was I who defeated the Dutch in the Battle of Colachel and ruled as a servant after dedicating my kingdom to the Lord.

riddle_original: ബ്രിട്ടീഷ് ഈസ്റ്റ് ഇന്ത്യാ കമ്പനിക്കെതിരെ പോരാടാൻ ഞാൻ വയനാടൻ കാടുകളിലേക്ക് പിൻവാങ്ങി. കീഴടങ്ങുന്നതിനേക്കാൾ നല്ലത് ഒരു വിമതനായി ജീവിക്കുന്നതാണെന്ന് കരുതിയ രാജാവാണ് ഞാൻ.
riddle_english: I retreated to the forests of Wayanad to fight against the British East India Company. I am the king who thought it better to live as a rebel than to surrender.

riddle_original: സാമൂതിരി വംശജനെങ്കിലും വാളിന് പകരം ഞാൻ തൂലികയും കണക്കുപുസ്തകവും തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു. കോഴിക്കോടിന് ആദ്യത്തെ നോവലും ബാങ്കും കലാലയവും നൽകിയവൻ ഞാൻ.
riddle_english: Though of Zamorin descent, I chose the pen and the abacus instead of the sword. I am the one who gave Kozhikode its first novel, bank and college.
riddle_hint: A lesser known novelist and banker from Kerala

riddle_original: ഒരേ പ്രസവത്തിൽ ഒരു മനുഷ്യപുത്രനും ഒരു സർപ്പത്തിനും ജന്മം നൽകിയ മണ്ണാണ് ഞാൻ. പാമ്പും മനുഷ്യനും സഹോദരങ്ങളായി വളർന്ന അത്ഭുത മന ഏതാണ്?
riddle_english: I am the soil that gave birth to a son of man and a serpent in one birth. What is the wonderful Mana that the serpent and the man grew up as brothers?
riddle_hint: A temple house in Palakkad, Kerala
riddle_note: Mostly known in the interior regions of Palakkad, Kerala

riddle_original: ഒരിക്കലും പ്രസവിക്കാത്ത ആട്?
riddle_english: A goat that never gives birth?
riddle_note: A place in Kerala. Pun on '-aadu' = goat.

riddle_original: വഴുവഴുപ്പുള്ള രാജ്യം?
riddle_english: The slippery country?
riddle_note: Wordplay on 'grease' = slippery.

riddle_original: ഏറ്റവും വേദനിക്കുന്ന രാജ്യം ഏതാണ്?
riddle_english: The country that hurts the most?
riddle_note: Pun: Spain = 'pain'.

riddle_original: വിശപ്പുള്ള രാജ്യം?
riddle_english: The hungry country?
riddle_note: Pun: Hungary = 'hungry'.

riddle_original: എന്നിലേക്ക് എത്താൻ നിങ്ങൾ കയറണം, ഞാൻ കുന്നുകളാൽ ചുറ്റപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു, പക്ഷേ ഞാൻ ഒരു കുന്നല്ല
riddle_english: You have to climb to reach me and I'm surrounded by hills but I'm not a hill myself
riddle_note: Wordplay on 'mala' which means hill.

riddle_original: ഞാൻ ഇന്ത്യയുടെ പേര് വഹിക്കുന്നു, പക്ഷേ ആളുകൾക്ക് പകരം ഞാൻ വെള്ളമാണ് വഹിക്കുന്നത്. ഞാൻ എന്താണ്?
riddle_english: I carry the name of India, but instead of people, I carry water. What am I?
riddle_note: The river's name has "Bharatha" in it, a river in Kerala

riddle_original: ഒരു മരത്തിൻ്റെ പേരിലാണ് എനിക്ക് പേരിട്ടത്, എന്നാൽ ഇപ്പോൾ ആളുകൾ കരുതുന്നത് എനിക്ക് ഒരേയൊരു പാലമേ ഉള്ളൂ എന്നാണ്. ഞാൻ എന്താണ്?
riddle_english: I was named after one tree, but now people think I have only one bridge. What am I?
riddle_note: The place was named after a single 'pala' tree but literally translates to one bridge now, specific to a place in Palakkad district of Kerala

riddle_original: എനിക്ക് അയൽവാസികളായി ഒരു കുരിശും ചന്ദ്രക്കലയും ഗോപുരവുമുണ്ട്, പക്ഷേ ഞാൻ ഒരു ഭൂപടത്തിലെ ഒരു സ്ഥലം മാത്രമാണ്. ഞാൻ എന്താണ്?
riddle_english: I have a Cross, a Crescent and a Gopuram as my neighbors, but I am just a single place on a map. what am I?
riddle_note: A famous junction in Kerala

riddle_original: മലബാറിൻ്റെ ശബരിമല എന്നറിയപ്പെടുന്ന സ്ഥലം?
riddle_english: What place is called the Malabar's Sabarimala?

riddle_original: തിരമാലകൾ തലോടുന്ന കടൽതീരം, സ്നേഹം പൂത്തുലയുന്ന ഇടം.
riddle_english: The shore of the sea where water laps and love blooms

riddle_original: കണ്ണൂരിലും ഞാനുണ്ട്, ബഹിരാകാശത്തും ഞാനുണ്ട്, കലണ്ടറിലും ഞാനുണ്ട്. ആരാണ് ഞാൻ?
riddle_english: I'm in Kannur, I'm in outer space, I'm in the calendar. Who am I?
riddle_hint: An instrument, art-form or word/letter puzzle.
riddle_note: Ka' is in Kannur, Kalavasthu (space), Kalandar (calendar); aksharam-riddle.

riddle_original: ആനയിലുണ്ട് ചേനയിലില്ല, ഇമയിലുണ്ട് ഇഷ്ട്ടത്തിലില്ല. രണ്ട് അക്ഷരമുള്ള ഞാനാര്?
riddle_english: Found in 'aana', not 'chena'; in 'ima', not 'ishtam'. Two syllables, who am I?
riddle_hint: An instrument, art-form, or word/letter puzzle.
riddle_note: Letter-puzzle in the Malayalam aksharam style.

riddle_original: അതെടുത്തിതിലേക്കിട്ടു, ഇതെടുത്തതിലേക്കിട്ടു.
riddle_english: Took that and put it here; took this and put it there.
riddle_hint: An instrument, art-form, or word/letter puzzle.

riddle_original: ഒരു പ്രത്യേക ദിവസത്തിൽ, സ്ത്രീകൾ നൃത്തം ചെയ്യാൻ ചുറ്റും കൂടുന്നു, ബീറ്റ് നൽകാൻ കൈകൾ ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു. എന്താണ് ഈ നൃത്തം?
riddle_english: On one special day, women gather around to dance, using their hands to provide the beat. What is this dance?
riddle_hint: A local dance form performed by women in Kerala

riddle_original: വട്ടത്തിൽ കറങ്ങി ഞാൻ നിറമുള്ള ഒരു ചുഴിയായി മാറുന്നു. ചെണ്ടയുടെ താളത്തിൽ, ചിറകു പോലുള്ള കൈകളുമായി ഞാൻ ദേവിയെ വിളിക്കുന്നു.
riddle_english: Spinning in circles I become a swirl of color. In the rhythm of chenda, I invoke the goddess with wings like arms.
riddle_hint: A local dance form performed during temple festivals

riddle_original: ഞാൻ നിറങ്ങൾക്ക് പകരം പൂക്കൾ കൊണ്ട് തീർത്ത ഒരു കലയാണ്. ആ പ്രതാപിയായ രാജാവിനെ വരവേൽക്കാൻ ഞാൻ മുറ്റത്ത് നിറയുന്നു.
riddle_english: I am an art made with flowers instead of colors. I fill the courtyard to welcome that glorious king.

riddle_original: പന്ത്രണ്ട് പേർ വട്ടത്തിൽ ചുവട് വെച്ച്, വെള്ളക്കുപ്പായം ധരിച്ച് ഞാൻ ആടുന്നു. കടൽ കടന്നു വന്ന ശ്ലീഹായുടെ ചരിത്രം ഞാൻ പാടി പറയുന്നു.
riddle_english: Twelve people step in a circle, dressed in a white robe, I swing. I sing the story of the Apostle who crossed the sea.
riddle_hint: A dance performed by the Christian community in Kerala

riddle_original: പണ്ട് തറിയുടെ താളത്തിൽ, നല്ല സ്വർണ്ണ നൂലുകൾ കൊണ്ട് ഞാൻ പിറന്നു. ഇന്ന് യന്ത്രങ്ങളുടെ ശബ്ദം എന്റെ നെയ്ത്തുകാരന്റെ പാട്ട് മായ്ക്കുന്നു. എന്റെ നിറം മങ്ങുകയാണ്, എന്റെ കലകൾ മറയുകയാണ്.
riddle_english: I was born to the beat of the old loom, with fine golden threads. Today the sound of machines drowns out my weaver's song. My color is fading, my arts are fading.
riddle_hint: A traditional weaving art in Kerala

riddle_original: വെള്ളത്തുണിക്ക് പിന്നിലെ വിളക്കിൻ വെട്ടത്തിൽ, നിഴലായ് വിരിയുന്ന ഇതിഹാസ കഥകൾ. തോലിൽ തീർത്ത രൂപങ്ങൾ ആടിടുമ്പോൾ, രാമായണ സാരമെന്നും പകർന്നിടുന്നു. ഞാൻ ആര്?
riddle_english: In the lamp cut behind the water cloth, epic stories unfolding in the shadows. As the skinned forms sway, Ramayana Sara is also poured. Who am i?
riddle_hint: A form of puppetry in Kerala
riddle_note: Primarily famous in Palakkad, Thrissur and Malappuram

riddle_original: മുഖംമൂടിയും കിരീടവും വെച്ച്, തുടികൊട്ടി തെരുവിലൂടെ ഞങ്ങൾ ആടുന്നു. ഒരു ഭൂതവും ദേവിയും ചേർന്ന ജോഡികൾ. ഞങ്ങൾ ആര്?
riddle_english: Wearing the mask and crown, we dance to the drums as we walk through the town. A spirit and a goddess in a pair. Who are we?
riddle_hint: A ritualistic folk dance in Kerala

riddle_original: വേഗത്തിൽ ഒന്നാമൻ, പേരിൽ രണ്ടാമൻ, സ്ഥാനത്തിൽ മൂന്നാമൻ ആരാണ്?
riddle_english: Who is first in speed, second in name and third in position?
reference_answer_english: The seconds hand of a clock
riddle_note: First in speed, 'second' in name, third in order - the seconds hand. Borderline Sports/Everyday.

riddle_original: തൃശ്ശൂരിൻ്റെ മണ്ണിൽ നിന്നും വളർന്ന്, കറുത്ത മുത്ത് എന്ന് അറിയപ്പെട്ടവൻ ഞാൻ. ഞാൻ ആര്?
riddle_english: Born from the soil of Thrissur, I am known as the black pearl. who am i

riddle_original: ഞാൻ ഒരു എക്സ്പ്രസ്സാണ്, പക്ഷെ ഓടുന്നത് റെയിലിലൂടെയല്ല. പയ്യോളി എന്ന ഗ്രാമത്തെ ലോകഭൂപടത്തിൽ എത്തിച്ചവൾ ഞാൻ. ഞാൻ ആര്?
riddle_english: I am an express, but not by rail. I am the one who put the village Paioli on the world map. Who am I?

riddle_original: നൂറു കാലുകളുണ്ടെങ്കിലും പാദങ്ങളില്ല, വെള്ളത്തിലൂടെ ചീറിപ്പായുമെങ്കിലും ഞാൻ പാമ്പല്ല. ഞാൻ ആര്?
riddle_english: I am not a snake, though I have a hundred legs and no feet, and slither through the water. Who am I?
riddle_hint: A water sport played in Kerala

riddle_original: മലബാറിൽ ഞാൻ ഒരിക്കലും മാറാത്ത ഒരു പനിയാണ്. ഞാൻ ഫുട്ബോളാണ്, പക്ഷേ കളിക്കാൻ ഏഴുപേർ മതി. ഞാൻ ആര്?
riddle_english: In Malabar I am a fever that never goes away. I'm football, but seven is enough to play. Who am I?
riddle_hint: A variation of football (soccer) famous in Kerala

riddle_original: ഒരു പന്തും ഏഴ് പരന്ന കല്ലുകളും ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ ഞാനുണ്ട്. ഒരു ടീം കല്ലുകൾ അടുക്കി വെക്കാൻ ശ്രമിക്കുമ്പോൾ മറ്റേ ടീം അത് പന്തുകൊണ്ട് എറിഞ്ഞു വീഴ്ത്തും
riddle_english: I have one ball and seven flat stones. One team tries to stack the stones while the other team knocks them down with balls. who I am?
riddle_hint: A traditional children's game played in India and Kerala

riddle_original: ഞാൻ ദൂരങ്ങളിലേക്കും വേഗത്തിലും ചാടി, പാരീസിലെ അഭിമാനകരമായ ആ വേദിയിൽ ഇന്ത്യയ്ക്ക് വേണ്ടി ആദ്യമായി മെഡൽ നേടിയവളാണ് ഞാൻ. ആരാണെന്ന് പറയാമോ?
riddle_english: I jumped far and fast and was the first to win a medal for India at that prestigious venue in Paris. Can you tell me who it is?
riddle_hint: A long jumper from Kerala, the first Indian to win a medal at the World Athletic Championship

riddle_original: നീളത്തിൽ ചാടിയും റെക്കോർഡുകൾ തകർത്തും എന്റെ രാജ്യത്ത് ആദ്യമായി ഞാൻ ചരിത്രം കുറിച്ചു. ഓട്ടവും എനിക്ക് വഴങ്ങുമായിരുന്നു, അങ്ങനെ ഞാൻ എന്റെ നാടിന് അഭിമാനമായി മാറി. ഞാൻ ആരാണ്?
riddle_english: I made history for the first time in my country by long jumping and breaking records. Running was also my thing and I became the pride of my country. Who am I?
riddle_hint: A track and field athelete from Kerala

riddle_original: നാല് വർഷത്തിലൊരിക്കൽ ഞാൻ എത്തുമ്പോൾ കേരളം ഒരു വിദേശരാജ്യമായി മാറും. സ്വന്തം നാടിന്റെ കൊടിയേക്കാൾ കൂടുതൽ ബ്രസീലിന്റെയും അർജന്റീനയുടെയും കൊടികൾ ഉയർത്തുന്ന ഈ ആവേശം ഏതാണ്?
riddle_english: Kerala becomes a foreign country when I visit once in four years. What is this enthusiasm that raises the flags of Brazil and Argentina more than the flag of their own country?

riddle_original: പ്രായഭേദമന്യേ എല്ലാവരും എന്നെ 'ചേട്ടാ' എന്ന് വിളിക്കുന്നു. വിഴിഞ്ഞത്തിന്റെ തീരത്ത് നിന്ന് ബാറ്റ് വീശി ഇന്ത്യൻ ടീമിലെത്തിയ താരം.
riddle_english: Irrespective of age, everyone calls me 'brother'. The player came to the Indian team by swinging the bat from the shores of Vizhinjam.

riddle_original: തിന്നില്ല കുടിയ്ക്കില്ല, തല്ലാതെ മിണ്ടില്ല.
riddle_english: It doesn't eat, doesn't drink and won't speak unless beaten.
riddle_hint: An instrument, art-form or word/letter puzzle.

riddle_original: വീട്ടിലെ കോവിലിൽ മൂന്നുണ്ട് ദൈവങ്ങൾ.
riddle_english: There are three gods in the home shrine.
riddle_note: Three gods in the home-temple = three stones of a traditional Kerala hearth. Culturally specific.

riddle_original: ഞാൻ കണ്ണാടി പോലെ തകർക്കാൻ കഴിയുന്ന ഒരു കണ്ണാടിയാണ്, പക്ഷേ ഞാൻ ജനിച്ചത് ഒരു കമ്മാരൻ്റെ കോട്ടയിലാണ്. ഞാൻ എന്താണ്?
riddle_english: I am a Mirror that can break like glass, but I was born in a Blacksmith's forge. what am I?
riddle_hint: A special type of mirror found in Kerala

riddle_original: ഒറ്റത്തടി മരമാണേ, വേരില്ലാ മരമാണേ, തുഞ്ചത്തു കാണുന്നതെന്തിലയോ, പൂവോ?
riddle_english: A single-trunked tree with no roots; is what you see at the top a leaf or a flower?
riddle_hint: A Kerala-specific tradition, ritual object, or regional staple.
riddle_note: A one-stemmed, rootless tree with something at the top, the kodimaram at a Kerala temple.

riddle_original: അമ്പലത്തിലുള്ള ചെമ്പകത്തിനു കൊമ്പില്ല.
riddle_english: The champaka tree at the temple has no branches.
riddle_hint: A Kerala-specific tradition, ritual object, or regional staple.
riddle_note: The champaka tree at the temple has no branches, kodimaram.

riddle_original: ഏറ്റവും വിലപിടിപ്പുള്ള നിധികൾക്ക് മുകളിൽ ഉറങ്ങുന്ന, മൂന്ന് വാതിലുകളിലൂടെ മഹാവിഷ്ണുവിനെ ആരാധിക്കാൻ ആളുകൾ എത്തുന്ന ഈ സ്ഥലം ഏതാണ്?
riddle_english: What is this place where people come to worship Lord Vishnu through three doors, sleeping on top of the most precious treasures?
riddle_hint: A national heritage temple in Kerala

riddle_original: നെല്ലിമരത്തിന്റെ ചുവട്ടിൽ കുടികൊള്ളുന്ന ദൈവം. അന്ത്യകർമ്മങ്ങൾക്കായി ഒഴുകുന്ന പുണ്യജലം. ബ്രഹ്മാവ് കണ്ടെത്തിയ ഈ ചെറിയ ഇടം ഏതാണ്?
riddle_english: The god who resides under the gooseberry tree. Holy water flowing for last rites. What is this small space found by Brahma?
riddle_hint: A national heritage temple in Kerala

riddle_original: പാലക്കാടൻ കാറ്റേൽക്കുന്ന ഈ ഗ്രാമത്തിൽ തുകലുകൾ പാട്ടുകളായി മാറും. മൃദംഗവും ചെണ്ടയും ഇവിടെ പിറവിയെടുക്കുന്നു.
riddle_english: Leathers turn into songs in this windy village of Palakkad. Mridanga and Chenda are born here.
riddle_hint: A village in Kerala famous for making percussion instruments from leather

riddle_original: മിഴാവിന്റെ മുഴക്കത്തിൽ കൂത്തമ്പലത്തിൽ ആടുന്ന കല. വാക്കുകളേക്കാൾ കൂടുതൽ കണ്ണുകൾ സംസാരിക്കുന്ന, സംസ്കൃത നാടകം ഏതാണ്?
riddle_english: The art of swaying to the sound of mizhavan. In which Sanskrit play, eyes speak more than words?
riddle_hint: A UNESCO heritage form from Kerala

riddle_original: ഞാൻ ഒരു ഗുഹയല്ല, രണ്ട് വലിയ പാറകൾക്കിടയിലെ വിടവാണ്. എന്റെ ചുവരുകളിൽ അയ്യായിരം വർഷം പഴക്കമുള്ള ചിത്രങ്ങൾ ഒളിഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.
riddle_english: I am not a cave, but a gap between two huge rocks. Five thousand year old paintings lurk on my walls.
riddle_hint: A natural landmark in Wayanad, Kerala

riddle_original: രണ്ടു കിണറിന് ഒരു പാലം.
riddle_english: One bridge for two wells.
riddle_hint: A part of the body or something a child sees daily.
riddle_note: Two wells with one bridge : nostrils and bridge.

riddle_original: ഒരമ്മയ്ക്ക് രണ്ട് മക്കൾ, ഓരോന്നിനും രണ്ട് നിറം.
riddle_english: One mother, two children, each with two colours.
riddle_hint: A part of the body or something a child sees daily.
riddle_note: One mother, two children, each with two colours : white and dark of the eye.

riddle_original: ഇരുട്ട് കണ്ടാൽ മറയും, വെളിച്ചം കണ്ടാൽ തുറക്കും.
riddle_english: It closes in the dark, opens in the light.
riddle_hint: A part of the body or something a child sees daily.
riddle_note: Some variants answer 'window'. Iris/pupil also fits.

riddle_original: പാൽമൊന്തയിൽ കരിമീൻ.
riddle_english: A black karimeen fish in a pot of milk.
riddle_hint: A part of the body or something a child sees daily.
riddle_note: Black fish in a pot of milk, dark pupil in white sclera. 'Karimeen' is Kerala's state fish.

riddle_original: ഒരു തൊഴുത്തിൽ രണ്ടുവരി വെള്ളക്കുതിര.
riddle_english: Two rows of white horses in one stable.
riddle_hint: A part of the body or something a child sees daily.
riddle_note: Two rows of white horses in one stable.

riddle_original: ആകാശത്തൊരു കൂട്ടിനുള്ളില്‍ മുപ്പത്തിരണ്ടു വെള്ളാന.
riddle_english: Thirty-two white elephants inside a little cage in the sky.
riddle_hint: A part of the body or something a child sees daily.
riddle_note: Thirty-two white elephants in a sky-cage explicit 'full set' riddle.

riddle_original: അടയ്ക്കും തുറക്കും കിങ്ങിണി പത്തായം.
riddle_english: A little jingling granary that opens and closes.
riddle_hint: A part of the body or something a child sees daily.

riddle_original: ഒരെരുത്തിൽ നിറച്ചു വെള്ളക്കാള.
riddle_english: A stable filled with white bulls.
riddle_hint: A part of the body or something a child sees daily.

riddle_original: ചെടി ചെടിയിന്മേൽ കായ് കയ്യിന്മേൽ ചെടി.
riddle_english: A plant on a plant, a fruit on a hand, a plant on the fruit.
riddle_hint: A part of the body or something a child sees daily.

riddle_original: ഇത്തിരി മുറ്റത്തഞ്ചാളുകൾ.
riddle_english: Five people in a tiny courtyard.
riddle_hint: A part of the body or something a child sees daily.
riddle_note: Five people in a tiny yard' = fingers on a palm.

riddle_original: കാലുപിടിക്കുന്നവനെ സംരക്ഷിക്കുന്നവൻ.
riddle_english: It protects whoever clasps its leg.
riddle_note: Whoever grasps its leg is protected.

riddle_original: അമ്മ കിടക്കും, മകളോടും.
riddle_english: The mother lies still; the daughter runs over her.
riddle_note: Mother lies still, daughter runs over her = masala stone.

riddle_original: വേനൽക്കാലത്തു മനുഷ്യനെ തങ്ങുന്ന ഭാരം?
riddle_english: The 'weight' that holds a person up in summer?
riddle_note: Sambharam : what 'supports' a human in summer. Kerala-specific drink.

riddle_original: ചുണ്ടില്ലെങ്കിലും ചിരിക്കും, കരയും, അട്ടഹസിക്കും?
riddle_english: Even without lips, I can laugh, cry and giggle.

riddle_original: അകത്ത് പോയപ്പോൾ പച്ച, പുറത്ത് വന്നപ്പോൾ ചുവപ്പ്.
riddle_english: Green going in, red coming out.
riddle_note: Green going in (betel leaf), red coming out (from the lime + areca).

riddle_original: ആളെ കണ്ടാല്‍ നിലവിളിക്കും, കൈകാണിച്ചാലവിടെ നില്‍ക്കും.
riddle_english: At the sight of people it cries out; show it your hand and it stops.

riddle_original: പൊന്ന് തിന്ന് വെള്ളി തുപ്പി.
riddle_english: Ate gold and spat out silver.

riddle_original: ദൈവം മനുഷ്യന് കൊടുത്ത ഏറ്റവും വലിയ വരം?
riddle_english: The greatest gift God gave to humans?
riddle_note: Pun — '-varam' suffix.

riddle_original: എഴുതാൻ പറ്റുന്ന ഡ്രസ്സ്?
riddle_english: The 'dress' you can write on?

riddle_original: ലോകത്ത് എല്ലായിടത്തും ഉള്ള പനി?
riddle_english: The 'fever' that exists everywhere in the world?
riddle_note: Pun: 'pani' = fever. Companies are everywhere.

riddle_original: ആയിരം കിളിക്ക് ഒരു കൊക്ക്, അത് എന്ത്?
riddle_english: A thousand birds but only one beak, what is it?
riddle_hint: It's a living thing, plant or animal.

riddle_original: വൈകുന്നേരമാകുമ്പോൾ ഈ വീട് വല്ലാതെ ബഹളമുണ്ടാക്കും. എന്താണിത്?
riddle_english: When evening comes, this house makes a lot of noise. What is it?
riddle_hint: It's a living thing, plant or animal.

riddle_original: വെളുത്ത അരിയും ഒരു തണുത്ത വെള്ളരിയും ഉപയോഗിച്ച് ഞാൻ എൻ്റെ പേര് പങ്കിടുന്നു, എന്നാൽ നിങ്ങൾ എപ്പോഴും ഓർക്കുന്ന ഒരു വേനൽക്കാല വിരുന്നാണ് ഞാൻ. ഞാൻ എന്താണ്?
riddle_english: I share my name with white rice and a cool cucumber, but I’m a summer treat that you’ll always remember. What am I?

riddle_original: ഞാൻ മഞ്ഞിൻ്റെ കിരീടം ധരിക്കുന്ന സുഗന്ധങ്ങളുടെ രാജാവാണ്, പക്ഷേ എനിക്ക് രാജ്യമില്ല, ഒരു പൂന്തോട്ടം മാത്രം. ഞാൻ എന്താണ്?
riddle_english: I am the King of Scents who wears a crown of snow, but I have no kingdom, only a garden. What am I?

riddle_original: ഞാൻ തീയും ചരടും കൊണ്ട് നിർമ്മിച്ച ഒരു കിരീടമാണ്, പക്ഷേ ഞാൻ ദൈവത്തിൻ്റെ തലയ്ക്ക് പകരം ഒരു തണ്ടിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്നു. ഞാൻ എന്താണ്?
riddle_english: I am a Crown made of fire and lace, but I sit on a stem instead of a God's head. What am I?

riddle_original: നമ്മളിൽ ഭൂരിഭാഗം ആളുകളും കഴിക്കുന്ന ആന?
riddle_english: The 'elephant' that most of us eat?
riddle_hint: A living thing — plant or animal.
riddle_note: English-loanword pun.

riddle_original: മേലേവീട്ടിലെ മുത്തശ്ശ്യമ്മേടെ പൊട്ടിച്ചിരിയും പേടിപ്പിക്കും.
riddle_english: The grandmother from upstairs has a terrifying laugh
riddle_hint: Something in nature or the sky.

riddle_original: ഒട്ടും വിലയില്ലാത്തതൊട്ടേറെ വിലയുള്ളതെല്ലാർക്കും ചത്താലും വേണ്ടതത്രേ.
riddle_english: Of no price, yet of every price; needed by all, even in death.
riddle_hint: Something in nature or the sky.

riddle_original: കയറാൻ പറ്റാത്ത കാർ?
riddle_english: A car you cannot board?
riddle_hint: Something in nature or the sky.
riddle_note: -kaar' suffix pun — rain-cloud.

riddle_original: കാണ്ടാൽ വണ്ടി, തൊട്ടാൽ ചക്രം.
riddle_english: Looks like a cart; touch it, and it becomes a wheel.
riddle_hint: A living thing — plant or animal.
riddle_note: Looks like a cart, becomes a wheel when touched (curls up).

riddle_original:
ഞാൻ ഒരു ഡോക്ടറല്ല, പക്ഷേ മനുഷ്യമനസ്സ് വായിച്ചു.
ഞാൻ ഒരു കൊലപാതകിയല്ല, പക്ഷേ എല്ലാവരും എന്നെ ഭയന്നു.
ഞാൻ ആരാണ്?
riddle_english:
I'm not a doctor, but I can read people's minds.
I'm not a murderer, but everyone is afraid of me.
Who am I?
riddle_hint: Name of a Malayalam movie character
riddle_note: The movie is a blockbuster mystery thriller film with an evergreen actor playing the lead role

riddle_original:
ഇന്ത്യൻ ടെറിട്ടോറിയൽ ആർമിയിൽ ഓണററി ലെഫ്റ്റനന്റ് കേണൽ പദവി ലഭിക്കുന്ന ആദ്യത്തെ ഇന്ത്യൻ നടനാണ് ഞാൻ.
ദാദാസാഹിബ് ഫാൽക്കെ അവാർഡും പത്മഭൂഷണും എനിക്ക് ലഭിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്.
എന്റെ കരിയറിലെ ആദ്യത്തെ സ്‌ക്രീൻ വേഷം ഒരു സാഡിസ്റ്റ് വില്ലനായിരുന്നു.
ഞാൻ ആരാണ്?
riddle_english:
I am the first Indian actor to become honorary Lieutenant Colonel, in the Indian Territorial Army.
I have received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award and the Padma Bhushan.
The first screen role of my career was a sadistic villain.
Who am I?

riddle_original: 1984-ൽ പുറത്തിറങ്ങിയ ഒരു മലയാളം 3D സിനിമയാണ് ഞാൻ. കറങ്ങുന്ന മുറിയിൽ കുട്ടികളെ ചുമരുകളിൽ നടക്കാൻ പ്രേരിപ്പിച്ചു. ഞാൻ ഏത് സിനിമയാണ്?
riddle_english: I am a Malayalam 3D film released in 1984. I made children walk on walls in a rotating room. Which film am I?

riddle_original:
ഒരു സിനിമയുടെ ക്ലൈമാക്സ് ഒരു ദിവസം മുമ്പ് മാറ്റി.
പ്രേക്ഷകർ ആഗ്രഹിച്ചത് സന്തോഷകരമായ ഒരു അന്ത്യമായിരുന്നു.
അവർക്ക് ലഭിച്ചത് ഒരു ക്ലിഫ്ഹാംഗർ ആയിരുന്നു.
സംവിധായകൻ ഇപ്പോഴും ആ തീരുമാനത്തെ ന്യായീകരിക്കുന്നു.
ഞാൻ ഏത് സിനിമയാണ്?
riddle_english:
The climax of a film was changed a day ago.
What the audience wanted was a happy ending.
What they got was a cliffhanger.
The director is still justifying the decision.
Which film am I?

riddle_original:
ഞാൻ ഒരു നാടകവേദിയിലാണ് ജനിച്ചത്, പക്ഷേ 417 ദിവസം ഞാൻ അവിടെ നിന്ന് പോകാൻ മടിച്ചു. പിന്നീട് ഒരു ഇതിഹാസ കൃതിയായി ഞാൻ അറിയപ്പെട്ടു.
ഞാൻ ഏത് സിനിമയാണ്?
riddle_english:
I was born in a theater, but I refused to leave for 417 days. Later I became known as a legendary work.
Which movie am I?

riddle_original:
ഒരു നടൻ ഒരു ആശയം കൊണ്ടുവന്നു, ഒരു സംവിധായകൻ അത് രൂപപ്പെടുത്തി.
ഒരു എഴുത്തുകാരൻ അതിനെ ഒരു ഇതിഹാസമാക്കി, പക്ഷേ ആ ആശയം കൊണ്ടുവന്ന നടൻ ആ സിനിമയിൽ അഭിനയിക്കുന്നില്ല
ഞാൻ ഏത് സിനിമയാണ്?
riddle_english:
An actor came up with an idea and a director shaped it.
A writer made it a legend but the actor who came up with the idea does not star in that film
Which film am I?

riddle_original:
സ്‌ക്രീനിൽ, ഞാൻ പലതവണ അവരുടെ ഭർത്താവാണ്. പക്ഷേ ആദ്യം ഞാൻ അവരുടെ മകനായിരുന്നു.
ഞാൻ ആരാണ്?
riddle_english:
On screen, I am her husband, many times. But first I was her son.
Who am I?
riddle_note: The actress being referenced is Kaviyoor Ponnama

riddle_original:
ആ ദിവസം ഞാൻ സെറ്റിൽ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല. പക്ഷേ ആ സീനിൽ എന്റെ ശബ്ദം കേൾക്കാം.
ഞാൻ ഏത് നടിയാണ്?
riddle_english:
I was not on the set that day. But you can hear me in that scene.
Which actress am I?
riddle_note: The scene belongs to a film called Manichitrathazhu.

riddle_original:
ഒരേ നായികയ്‌ക്കൊപ്പം നൂറിലധികം സിനിമകളിൽ ഞാൻ അഭിനയിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്.
ഒരു വർഷത്തിനുള്ളിൽ ഞാൻ 39 സിനിമകൾ പോലും ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ട്.
എന്റെ പേര് ഗിന്നസ് റെക്കോർഡിൽ ഉണ്ട്, പക്ഷേ ആരും എന്റെ യഥാർത്ഥ പേരിൽ എന്നെ വിളിച്ചിട്ടില്ല.
ഞാൻ ആരാണ്?
riddle_english:
I have performed in more than 100 films opposite the same heroine.
I've even done 39 films in a year.
My name is in the Guinness Records, but no one calls me by my real name.
Who am I?
riddle_note: An evergreen actor in the Malayalam Film Industry, with his peak in the 1970s

riddle_original:
നാല് ഭാഷകളിലായി ഒരു ദിവസം 16 പാട്ടുകൾ ഞാൻ പാടി.
ഏഴ് തവണ നാല് ഭാഷകളിലായി എനിക്ക് ദേശീയ അവാർഡ് ലഭിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്.
കേരളത്തിൽ ഏറ്റവും കൂടുതൽ അംഗീകരിക്കപ്പെട്ട ശബ്ദമാണ് ഞാൻ.
ഞാൻ ആരാണ്?
riddle_english:
I sang 16 songs a day in four languages.
I have received a National Award in four languages, seven times.
I am the most recognized voice in Kerala.
Who am I?
riddle_hint: Name of a Malayali playback singer

riddle_original: Akuoy in momomarentah molantud Kon lopa' in Bolaang Mongondow, sinangoyan Ki ine akuoy...
riddle_english: I am the almighty ruler of the Mongondow region. What is my name?

riddle_original: Akuoy mo ahli Kon urusan in tundi bo mongongundam, no bali' intaw modiyug ko i raja...Ki Ine akuoy...
riddle_english:
I am the companion of a bogani; I am often referred to by those who understand astrology, 
experts in diseases and their treatments. Who am I?

riddle_original: Akuoy in punu' molantud pertama Kon Bolaang Mongondow, Yo Ki Ine in akuoy?
riddle_english: know astrology often refer to me. Who am I?

riddle_original: Akuoy intau pertama kon bumi bolaang mongondow, Ki ine in akuoy?
riddle_english:
I am the first resident of 
Bolaang Mongondow. Who am I?

riddle_original: Sinangoyan Ki Ine in keluarga turunan in raja Kon Bolaang Mongondow ..
riddle_english: What is the term for the royal family in Bolaang Mongondow?

riddle_original: Akuoy in punu' molantud terakhir Kon lopa' in Bolaang mongondow siapa aku?
riddle_english:
I am the last king of Bolaang 
Mongondow, Who am i

riddle_original: Akuoy in momimpin Kon poyosipunan in masyarakat, sinangoyan onu akuoy...
riddle_english: I am the leader of a community organization. What is my title?

riddle_original: Onu Mako in syarat mojadi bogani ?
riddle_english: What are the essential qualities that a bogani must possess?
riddle_note: There are 4 requirements to become a bogani (Leader of the society)

riddle_original: Onu in paloko bo Ki kinalang tuwa?
riddle_english: What do “paloko” and “kinalang” mean?

riddle_original: Kon masa raja Ki Ine in mulai nomake in gelar raja?
riddle_english: When did the title of “datu” or “king” first come into use?

riddle_original: Puya' bagu no i lahir bo nodiya Kon takit biasa tangoyan Ki Ine...
riddle_english: What was the name given to the child who had been sickly since birth?

riddle_original: Puya' no i lahir Kon bonu in peristiwa moloben biasa tangoyan Ki Ine...
riddle_english: What is the name given to a child born on the day of a major event?

riddle_original: Akuoy in keturunan raja bo datu' Kon lopa' in Bolaang Mongondow, akuoy kinumaday Kon agama Islam, Ki Ine tangoyku..
riddle_english:
I am a member of a noble family who practices 
Islam in the Mongondow region.Who am I?

riddle_original: Parang no terjadi Kon tahun 1903-1904 Kon bonu in pomarentahan i Sangadi lipu pontodon tangoynya Ki Eman. Onu tangoy parang tatuwa...
riddle_english: The battle led by Sangadi Eman of Pontondon in 1903–1904 Is that called a war?

riddle_original: Kon taong tongonu in agama Islam no i angoy Kon lopa' in Bolaang Mongondow?
riddle_english: In what year did Islam arrive in Bolaang Mongondow?

riddle_original: Akuoy in pulau no intok no i lahir Kon bencana moloben Kon Bolaang Mongondow kolipod. Kon bonu in 40 no singgay uyan bo tompot moloben noko pilat ko i nako takin bulud in babo'..pulau onu tangoy ku?
riddle_english:
I am the island formed by the greatest natural disaster in Bolaang Mongondow. It rained for 40 days, accompanied by
lightning, thunder, and a violent storm, which caused Mount Babo to split apart and give birth to me. What is the name
of this island?

riddle_original: Akuoy in nodiya Kon agama Islam Kon lopa' in Bolaang Mongondow. Akuoy nonikah ko i putri raja bo nomiya Kon agama Islam no bali' agama Kon kerajaan. Ki Ine akuoy...
riddle_english:
I was the one who introduced Islam to the Kingdom of Bolaang Mongondow; I married the king’s daughter 
and succeeded in establishing Islam as the state religion. What is my name?

riddle_original: Akuoy Budaya leluhur yang salalu Aidan in masyarakat Bolaang mongondow Kotompodan in dolom 26,27,28 Kon bonu in bulan  puasa , sinangoyan onu in akuoy...
riddle_english:
What is the tradition commonly practiced by the Bolaang Mongondow community on the 26th, 27th, and 28th nights
of Ramadan?

riddle_original: Masa pinonguasaan in raja-raja Kon Bolaang Mongondow, nongkon raja pertama sampe Don Kon raja ko onom in sinangoyan masa onu in tuwa....
riddle_english:
The period during which the kings ruled Bolaang Mongondow, from the reign of the first king
to the sixth king, is known as the...

riddle_original: Akuoy pinercaya i raja Kon pomarentahannya bo bali' totaba' i raja mopodapot in parentah Kon ata bo masyarakat in lipu', sinangoyan Ki Ine akuoy...
riddle_english:
The chief executive of the government represents the king and serves as the king’s liaison with other government officials
and the people. What is this position called?

riddle_original: Kon onda tampat pinogutunan guyanga tungkul tua?
riddle_english: Where did the ancestors of the Bolaang Mongondow tribe live?

riddle_original: kon onda pinonampatan karajaan i raja kon abad 17 modapot kon abad 19
riddle_english: Where was the king's palace located from the 17th century to the late 19th century?

riddle_original:
akuoi noiukat kon utara buta’ pulau sulawesi, ilumanggo nongkon barat nadapot kon timur bo noiukat kon yuak in kabupaten 
gonontalon bo minahasa. Onu tangoi tampatku?
riddle_english:
I am located in the northern part of Sulawesi Island, stretching from west to east and bordered
by two other regencies, namely Gorontalo and Minahasa. Which region am I in?

riddle_original: Onu tangoy 'Ki Ina in lipu lopa' in Bolaang Mongondow'
riddle_english: What is the capital city of Bolaang Mongondow Regency?

riddle_original: kon onda tampat pertama in pinosindogan kon karajaan bolaang mongodow?
riddle_english: Where was the first capital of the Bolaang Mongondow Kingdom located?

riddle_original: kon taong 1480 m pinamping in tampat kerajaan bolaang mongondow, kon ondakah tampat ini pinomampingan kerajaan
riddle_english:
In 1480 AD, the capital of the Bolaang Mongondow Kingdom was relocated. Where was the Bolaang Mongondow Kingdom
located after the relocation?

riddle_original:
kon onda tampat in pinomampingan karajaan bolaang mongondow i raja laloda taong 1665 M sin salalu
poyotuluon in balanda
riddle_english:
Where did King Laloda relocate the capital of the Bolaang Mongondow Kingdom in 1665 AD 
after becoming deeply troubled by the Dutch’s attempts to sow discord?

riddle_original: kon masa pomarentahan i raja yakobus manoppo, tampat in kerajaan pinamping kon onda?
riddle_english: During the reign of King Yakobus Manoppo, where was the seat of the kingdom moved?

riddle_original: Kon onda ki Raja Salomon Manoppo binuni walu notaong ko onggotnya ?
riddle_english: Where was King Solomon Manoppo exiled for eight years?

riddle_original: kon onda in tampat danau moat ?
riddle_english: Where is the moat lake located?

riddle_original: Akuoy in pinomiya nongkon bahan logam, bongkugon in kayu ba mosingong in akuoy. Biasa pake'on Kon acara ponika'an andeka pojemputan Kon tamu Ki no Bangkal, alat musik onu in tangoyku....
riddle_english:
I am made of metal and played by striking me; I am usually played at aristocratic weddings
or when welcoming distinguished guests. What musical instrument am I?

riddle_original: Akuoy in tarian, biasa Aidan aka bolian mulai Don mongundam Kon intaw no takit, inimbalu' andeka dinatogan in mogoguyang, biasanya takin duduyan in singog in golantung aka mulai don akuoy mongundam. Tari onu in tangoyku...
riddle_english:
I used to be led in dance by a bolian or burangin—a woman in a trance—accompanied by
the sounds of the gimbal and golantung. What kind of dance is this?

riddle_original: Tarian tana'a biasanya Aidan in adik lolaki mogatod Kon raja atau mogatod kon pengantin lolaki Mayak Kon baloy in pengantin bobay. Tarian onu akuoy...
riddle_english:
I am led by a man while escorting the king or the groom to the bride’s house.
What kind of dance is this?

riddle_original: Akuoy in tarian potomu Kon tamu, tari onu tangoyku...
riddle_english: I am a dance that is often performed to welcome guests. What dance am I?

riddle_original: Akuoy in Seni mosingog Kon o igum ko i Togi kawasa aka oyu'on in hajatan polantikan Kon punu' molantud, Ki Ine tangoyku...
riddle_english:
Literary works such as the prayers recited, for example, at the inauguration of Punu' Molantud
or other high-ranking officials are literary works

riddle_original: Akuoy biasa posingog in punu' molantud aka lantikon Don in sia, onu tangoyku..
riddle_english:
What is the literary art form of the oaths recited, for example, at the inauguration of 
Punu' Molantud or other high-ranking officials?

riddle_original: Akuoy in podendang monia aka Mayak Don motayak Kon simuton Kon lopa' in bulud, onu tangoynya...
riddle_english:
What is the name of the melodic literature sung by the Bogani people or by locals who travel
to make salt or go into the forest to collect resin?

riddle_original: Akuoy Aidan in guhanga, takin adat in lipu' aka momulai Don monompiya Kon lipu' in mosia takin  mogimbalu' Kon mogoguyang in lipu, onu tangoy ku
riddle_english: A village healing ceremony, worship of ancestral spirits, or a sacrifice is called a ceremony?

riddle_original: Akuoy Podendang in bobay minta aka mulai don mokoyut kon payoy rontokon, lagu onu in tangoyku
riddle_english:
This song is sung while harvesting rice; it’s usually sung by women
to relieve the fatigue of working. What song is this?

riddle_original: Akuoy in podendang monia aka Kon acara tayow nobiyag bo modeyaga, biasanya oyu'on in momanari joke' bo ilamba'an in salendang in modeyaga. Lagu onu tangoynya...
riddle_english:
It is often sung at festive gatherings of young people or when a man
is dancing the “joke,” a dance in which the girls drape a shawl over him. What song is this?

riddle_original:
Itog in salalu pogogitog adi' Bobay ta momake Bondu bo dongka mo dia kon tampat binonuan baga bo dongka diaan
 kon baloi adi' Lolaki. Onu tangoi itog natua ?
riddle_english:
A game often played by a girl involving scented powder, in which the girl
carries an incense burner filled with embers to a young man’s house—what is this game called?

riddle_original:
Itog tasalalu pogogitog adi' lolaki momake Bal naanda bal pokateon. adi' lolaki musti maya mogadop bo dongka tayakon 
adi' ibanya ta mobali mololukad. Onu tangoi itog tanaah ?
riddle_english:
A game often played by young people using a soccer ball: when the ball is kicked,
the players must hide until they are found by the person on guard. What is this game?

riddle_original: Sipat in buta totabuan Tua in andolan nami adi' Mongondow. Molukad kon tobatu hal ta moko tabe kon pikiran. Onu tua ?
riddle_english:
The ground line on the Totabuan field is our wall. The children of Mongondow run 
to avoid a single touch that could bring down the entire fortress of illusion. 
Who am I?

riddle_original:
Akuoi salalu pogogitog kon Lomba 17 Agustus. Aka akuoi mo labu bui simindog bo lumanduk-landuk moi dapat kon garis Finis. 
Onu tangoi itog tanaah ?
riddle_english:
I’m often played during the August 17th celebrations. If you fall, you can still get back up.
To win, you have to keep jumping until you reach the finish line. What sport
am I?

riddle_original: Itog tanaayah salalu pakeon kon Lipu Mongondow bo totok mo populer. Tangoi Tim nami PERSIBOM. Yo onu tangoi itog tatua ?
riddle_english:
This sport is very popular in the Mongondow region; we used to have a team we were proud of called 
Persibom. What is the name of this sport?

riddle_original:
Tangoi in tampat poyodungkulan Nami kon lipu in Totabuan PB- LOKU Komoditas ta inator nami kon udara yo bola mo budo 
ta mo gaan bo molikat. Ki ine akuoi. ?
riddle_english:
The name of my club in Totabuan is PB-LOKU; the item we toss through the air
is a light, white, high-speed ball. Who am I?

riddle_original:
Kon Tubig ongkag kon buta in Totabuan akuoi mo bali' bokol mo miakon arus kon tudu in tubig bo dia moidapot kon oyuk in tubig bo 
tonga Napas, takin siol bo lima po bagaraku. Onu tangoi in olah raga tana aya ?.
riddle_english:
In the waters of Ongkag in Totabuan, I glide through the current without touching the bottom. 
All I need is breath control and the movement of my arms and legs. What kind of sport is this?

riddle_original:
Kami mogogitog mo miakon dewa no barisan bo mobaku mangada takin Lawan na anda ki ketua regu mo kala mosuten yo kami 
musti mo basiap maya molukad kon Gawang sin lawan regu palat maya mo lagui bo mo gadop. Onu tangoi itog tana aya ?
riddle_english:
We play by forming two lines that face each other. 
As soon as the team captain loses the suten, we have to get ready to guard the goal because the other team will immediately
run and hide. What game is this?

riddle_original:
Silop mo bali senjata pogantod kon buta itog tana aya beresi doman bo mogogitog Kasti tonga kon kasti mo 
make bal senjatanya aka na aya silop. Yo onu tangoi itog tana aya ?
riddle_english:
The footwear of the Mongondow children is repurposed as a throwing weapon in the yard. The rules are similar to rounders, 
but the ball is something you usually step on every day. What game is this?

riddle_original:
Akuoi no limbung tonga bi no bubu- bubu' pinomia nongkon kayu rotan ta inyanyam no alus aka mopogogitog ko inako yo musti bi 
lumanduk bo mo salto kon udara bo seakan kita dia bi kolima. Ki ine akuoi ?
riddle_english:
I’m round but full of holes, woven from Totabuan rattan. If you want to play with me, 
you’ll have to do a somersault in the air and pretend you don’t have hands. Guess what I am?

riddle_original: Onuin tangoy baloy adat Bolaang Mongondow?
riddle_english: What's the name of Bolaang Mongondow house called?

riddle_original: Aka aindon bulan puasa andeka bulan in sya'ban yo onu  aidan in bayongan intau mongondow ?
riddle_english: When Ramadan arrives—specifically during the month of Sha'ban—do people hold events?

riddle_original: Onu tangoy in poyodungkulan in bayongan Bobato monantu' kon tgl 1 ramadhan?
riddle_english:
What is the name of the meeting of village heads to discuss the determination of the first day of
Ramadan?

riddle_original: Onu tangoy ramean tapomiayaan aka mo toyongdon mopalut in bulan puasa mo nyonsong kon idul Fitri?
riddle_english:
What are the activities held toward the end of the Ramadan fast to celebrate Eid al-
Fitr called?

riddle_original: Akuoi tampat po sembahan ko i Ompu Duata, poguman in tangoy tampat tana'a?
riddle_english: I am a temple dedicated to Ompu Duata. What is the name of this place?

riddle_original: Kougatmay mosadia kon pomama' in leluhur bolaang mongondow yo pongonuan in tangoynya?
riddle_english:
Upacara penyembahan terhadap roh leluhur bolaang mongondow dengan menyediakan sajian
sesajen adalah upacara?

riddle_original: Oaidan mo mubuk kon da'un in bongolan in adi' bobay. Yo mongonu natua in tangoynya?
riddle_english: What is the name of the family ceremony in which a young girl’s earlobes are pierced?

riddle_original: Oaidan mongodeaga bo tayowmobiag aka mo toyong don monikah, yo oaidan onu in tangoynya?
riddle_english:
What is the ceremony held by the Bolaang Mongondow community for young men and women, which aims to 
mark their transition from adolescence to young adulthood as they enter into marriage?

riddle_original: Adat pongundaman ta pinake kon kino Lotangan Mokodoludut ta saat sia salalu mo takit-takit. Onu tangoi adatnya ?
riddle_english: What is the healing ceremony that began when the sickly Mokodoludut was born?

riddle_original: Adat ta pomiyaan kon kino patoyan in Raja-raja bo podendangan kon lagu kopatoyan andeka dete-dete sinangoyan onu ?
riddle_english:
The ceremony held upon the death of kings, during which mourning songs or “detet-detet” are sung,
is called a ceremony?

riddle_original: Itog ta mo igum Kon mama'an, mo igum Kon insilan, mo igum Kon labaku, Yo onu tangoynya....
riddle_english: What is the game accompanied by the dialogue “Ogayaipa mama'an, ogoyaipa insilan, ogoyaipa in labaku”?

riddle_original:
Mogogitog Kon sawah bo momake' in lolutam nongkon aog Simba diyak angoyon in lagapan ka'anon in payoy koyogot don 
momonuh in payoynya, biasanya tongak bik Aidan aka payoy mulai Don momusir, onu tangoy itog natuwa...
riddle_english:
A seasonal game that often takes place when the rice in the fields begins to ripen; in this game, children
must protect the rice from flocks of birds using a weapon made of bamboo.
What is the name of this game?

riddle_original: Ki Ine tangoyku...keunikanku in tongak bik popolayug bo uguton. Aka oyuon in tompot Yo Lebe molantud in layuganku, ta aka diyak in tompot Yo molabu' bik akuoy...
riddle_english:
Here’s the thing about me: the more you pull me back and forth, the higher I can fly. 
But if the wind in the sky suddenly dies down, I’ll immediately plummet to the ground. What game am I?

riddle_original: Akuoy in itog mo unik sin molanggo in awak ku bo mogaris-garis in kulitku. Aka pogogitog Yo tulu' in poluwayonku takin singog molangon bo moropot, na beresi singog in lolutam moparang, Aka moibog Lebe molangon in singogku Yo musti salalu irupon Kon bubu' nointok pinasang kon badanku...
riddle_english:
I’m long, green, and segmented, but I can shoot fire and make a thunderous sound like a weapon of war. 
Here’s the twist: you have to blow into my little hole first to get me to “scream.” What game am I?

riddle_original: Ki Ine akuoy, salalu pake'on pogogitog in mongoadik aka mulai don monguyan andeka nopalut Don in uyan sin tubig in uyan nongkon bulud bo mamonag Kon got in totok pa morogot...
riddle_english:
This game is popular among children during the rainy season or shortly after the rainy season
ends, when the streams in the ditches are still flowing strongly, carrying rainwater runoff from the mountains

riddle_original: Ki Ine akuoy... Aka mogogitog Yo tongak bik momake' in tononuyu' bo takin in yobayat moanto' adik bobay kira-kira tayalima in biasanya mo ibog mogogitog na na'a..
riddle_english:
A finger game, usually played by girls 
in groups of five or six. The children sit in a circle 
on the floor with their legs crossed. What is this game?

riddle_original: Itog ta na' a in salalu Aidan Kon bonu in taong, pinomiya in mongoadik pomonu Kon waktu bersenang monia aka mo inggu' Don mosia Kon ongkag. Gama'an Kon waktu dolodolom andeka mololabung, paling morame aka singgay in Ahad sin moanto' in mongoadik moyosipun Kon ongkag bo mogogitog na na'a.. onu tangoy itog tatuwa...
Oyu'on in tolu in bubu' no intok Noyo duduyan in tampatnya bo Ki Ine in mogogitog Yo musti momonu Kon bubu' tatuwa bo kotompodon sampe mopulu' in bonunya, Itog onu in tangoynya....
riddle_english:
In this game, there are three holes in a row that the player must fill; each hole is spaced a certain distance apart, 
and the player must fill them up to ten times. What game is this?

riddle_original: Mogogitog Kon itog tana'a momake' in silop pomongkug bo bal. Aka bal bo no i tugat Kon siol in lawan main Yo sangsinya in siolnya in bongkugon in silop. Onu tangoy in itog tana'a
riddle_english:
In this game, a sandal is used as a bat, and a soccer ball is the ball being hit; if the ball
hits someone’s foot, that person’s foot is then hit with the sandal. What is this game?

riddle_original: Alat pogogitog pake'on Kon itog tana'a in tongonu no kanikir sinangoy gaco, onu in tangoy itog tana'a...
riddle_english:
The equipment used in this game consists of a number of marbles that serve as the core of the game, known as gaco.
What kind of game is this?

riddle_original: Pogukatan Kon adat Kon urusan in ponika'an in ta aindon pinoyosingog muna in sinangoyan onu?
riddle_english:
What is the term for the transfer of marital 
property in a marriage plan that has been established 
through mutual agreement?

riddle_original:
Onu in ponangoy Kon lolaki diyak bik no satuju Kon ponika'annya bo harusnya bik tarimaan padahal sia in 
diyak bik moibog takin keluarga posi botak...
riddle_english:
What is the term for a man who forcibly declares 
himself married even though
neither party consents?

riddle_original: Onu in ponangoy Kon adik lolaki bo adik bobay no laguy Kon keluarga bo nonikah ?
riddle_english: What is the term for eloping?

riddle_original: Onu in pinopangkat Kon adik lolaki ta inumundok kon urusan in ponika'annya?
riddle_english:
An expression used for someone who must 
pay compensation

riddle_original: Gotong royong membangun kepentingan desa, balai desa, mesjid, gereja, sekolah lapangan olah raga, dan lain-lain disebut?
riddle_english:
What is the term for working together to build village f
acilities, such as village halls, mosques, churches, schools,
sports fields, and so on?

riddle_original: Moyokapit bo moyobamban bo dulu mogurus kon urusan in intaw andeka keluarga, in sinangoyan mongonu in tuwa....
riddle_english:
What is the term for cooperation and mutual assistance in
jointly overcoming difficulties or organizing an event?

riddle_original: Moposad bo mobantung Kon urusan in intaw Kon goba' andeka Kon Baloi monia in biasa sinangoyan mongonu natuwa?
riddle_english:
What is the term for working together to help an individual or a family
in a village community, such as building a house or plowing a rice field?

riddle_original: Tangoyon onu in intaw ta mo i liyuw don in kurang ajarnya?
riddle_english: An expression for someone who is too rude

riddle_original: Tangoyan onu in intaw ta tongak momiya Kon huru hara Kon lipu' ?
riddle_english:
An expression for someone who causes a 
commotion in the village

riddle_original: Onu in poku'uk Kon adik bobay bo adik olaki kon masyarakat in Bolaang Mongondow?
riddle_english: What are the nicknames for girls and boys in Bolaang Mongondow?
