riddle_original: Akuoy in alat musik kon daerah Bolaang Mongondow. Tongak bik ukaton Kon bibig Yo mosingog Don in akuoy...onu tangoyku?
riddle_english:
I'm often played in the mouth area; what are they called in the 
Bolaang Mongondow region

riddle_original: Akuoy na beresi gitar. Notongkay doman in alat musik nongkon Riau, onu in tangoyku aka Kon Bolaang Mongondow?
riddle_english:
I'm shaped like a guitar; I resemble a musical instrument from Riau. What am I called 
in the Mongondow region?

riddle_original: Akuoy na beresi stringbass, sinangoyan onu akuoy Kon Bolaang Mongondow?
riddle_english: I am a type of bass guitar. What is I’m called in the Mongondow region?

riddle_original: Akuoy na beresi ropol, onu in tangoyku aka Kon Bolaang Mongondow?
riddle_english: I am a kind of ropol, what is my name in the Mongondow region?

riddle_original: Akuoy in pake'on monggaing Kon gina in intaw, Ki Ine akuoy?
riddle_english: I am a kind of reed; what is my name in the Mongondow region?

riddle_original: Aka Kon tampat ibanya tangoyku suling, yo aka Kon Bolaang Mongondow in sinangoyan onu?
riddle_english:
People often call me “Suling” in the archipelago, but my nickname 
is different in Mongondow. Guess what my nickname is

riddle_original: Akuoy in alat musik no populer Kon Bolaang Mongondow. Akuoy nongkon bambu bo aka irupon Yo mosingog in akuoy, onu in tangoyku?
riddle_english:
I am a popular musical instrument in the Mongondow region; I am a 
wind instrument made of bamboo. What am I called?

riddle_original: Akuoy in lagu koyow nongkon Guyanga bo mopotorop Kon adik minta, onu in judulku?
riddle_english:
I am a folk song that refers to the ancestral homeland of the Mongondow people. Guess the title of 
my song

riddle_original: Akuoy in lagu daerah Bolaang Mongondow, yang mengandung arti momuji Kon mogoguyang bo lopa' in Bolaang Mongondow, onu in judulku?
riddle_english:
I am a song that serves as a reminder from parents 
to their children. What is the title of my song?

riddle_original: Akuoy lagu yang mongurai Kon bonu in gina intaw minayak norantau bo mokotanob Kon lipu' ku, onu judul laguku na'a?
riddle_english:
I Am is a song about someone who has moved away but
still loves their hometown. What is the title of this song?

riddle_original:
Pinomiya nongkon koito' bo binaukan in gula mopura takin Bango kinayug, mota'aw doman pake'an in pododungu. 
Kay monia akuoy in pizza Mongondow...Ki Ine akuoy?
riddle_english:
I’m made from sago, palm sugar, and shredded coconut. I’m often called Mongondow pizza.
What is the name of this dish?

riddle_original:
Kay monia akuoy in snek no mahal sin tongak bik pomiya'an aka idul Fitri Don...dungkul mai ukaton poka'anan in datu' bo punu' 
molantud sin tongak bik ka'anon totaong komintan dungu'on...Ki Ine akuoy?
riddle_english:
I am a traditional snack of the Bolaang Mongondow tribe, and I was also a delicacy of the Bolaang Mongondow royal court
in ancient times, typically made only once a year in the lead-up to the
Eid al-Fitr celebration. What is the name of this snack?

riddle_original: Biasanya Kon hajatan akuoy no balik koka'anon mopira, pinomiya nongkon bogat Pulo sinampuran in gula mopura, Ki Ine tangoyku
riddle_english:
I’m made from white glutinous rice and red glutinous rice, mixed with palm sugar.
I’m often served at celebrations as a side dish. What is the name of this dish?

riddle_original:
Toigu pulo no gu'od bo sampuran in gula mopura takin tubig in Bango, ka'anon mopatu bo motumping tumpala bik mosadap 
in nanamnya..Ki Ine akuoy
riddle_english:
Made from sweet corn and mixed with brown sugar, I’m often eaten when gathering with
my beloved family. What is the name of this dish?

riddle_original: Bogat Pulo sampuran in pododungu' bo ilutu' Kon bonu in aog, Ki Ine akuoy
riddle_english:
Made from glutinous rice mixed with natural spices such as ginger, shallots,
and other herbs. It’s cooked inside a bamboo tube—what is the name of this dish?

riddle_original: Ki Ine akuoy, Modarag in warnaku, dinungu takin pododungu bo bakuton Kon daun woka
riddle_english:
I’m made from rice mixed with natural spices, then wrapped
in woka leaves, just like how you’d wrap wajik. What’s the name of this dish?

riddle_original: Da'un in kapaya no gu'od dinungu takin tubig in Bango bo sinampuran in pododungu, onu tangoyku?
riddle_english: I am a vegetable dish made with papaya leaves and coconut milk. What is the name of this dish?

riddle_original:
Akuoy makanan favorit intaw Mongondow, tiap lipu' toposi bik doman in pododungu' monia tapi tangoy ku tetap bik tongak tobatu, 
pinomiya nongkon kulit bo lemak in sapi, Ki Ine akuoy
riddle_english:
I’m usually cooked during Eid al-Adha; I’m made with meat, and I’m cooked for a very long time—
for hours on end. What is this dish called?

riddle_original: Akuoy no make in renda, salalu ukaton Kon acara keluarga, gula mopura bo bogat ketan in bahan dasarnya ..Ki Ine akuoy
riddle_english: I’m made from a dough of rice flour and brown sugar, then fried. What is the name of this dessert?

riddle_original:
Tangoyku sesuai doman in warnaku, nomake pododungu kon bolaang Mongondow, 
akuoy in pinomiya nongkon bahan dasar bogat Pulo bo tubig in Bango takin pododungu. Ki Ine akuoy
riddle_english:
My name matches my color; I’m made with spices from Bolaang Mongondow, and my main ingredients are rice and coconut.
What’s my name?

riddle_original: حاجيتك ما جيتك... على واحد الدار كبيرة ومشهورة في قلب العاصمة، البيبان ديالها محلولين بالهضرة والخطابات، فيها كيتجمعوا ناس من كل مدينة وقرية، كاين اللي جاي يدافع على الحقوق والمنفعة، وكاين اللي كيوصل صوت المواطن في كل واقعة...
riddle_english: I have a riddle for you... about a large and famous house in the heart of the capital, its doors are opened with talk and speeches, where people from every city and village gather, some come to defend rights and interests, and some convey the voice of the citizen in every event...

riddle_original: أنا لي كبر من المقاطعة، وعندي كتقاد وراقك المهمة، والشاف ديالي سميتو العامل
riddle_english: I am larger than a district, where your important documents are prepared, and my boss is called the Governor.

riddle_original: أنا لي حافظ الحومة دار بدار، وخبارك كلها عندي، وبلا بيا ما تقدر تصاوب شهادة السكنى.
riddle_english: I am the protector of the neighborhood, house by house; I have all your news, and without me, you cannot obtain a residence certificate.

riddle_original: أنا ورقة كيحلم بيها شحال من واحد، بيا الطاكسي كيخدم، ومولايا كيكريني ويشد الفلوس وهو جالس فدارو
riddle_english: I am a piece of paper that many people dream of, through me the taxi operates, and my owner rents me out and collects money while sitting at home.

riddle_original: انا لحاجة لي كايطيها لملك لناس لي برزو مزيان ف شي حاجة يا يما ف لفن، لعلم ولا ف شؤون لبلاد
riddle_english: I am a thing that the King gives to people who have excelled in something, whether in art, science, or state affairs.

riddle_original: انا لي الا بغيتي تزوج خاص ضروري تحضرني
riddle_english: I am the one that if you want to get married, you must have me.

riddle_original: انا لي تزاديت ف سطات و وليت وزير الداخلية مع الحسن الثاني
riddle_english: I was born in Settat and became Minister of the Interior under Hassan II.

riddle_original: أنا أعلى وثيقة فلبلاد، بيا كتنظم السلطات والحقوق والواجبات ديال المواطنين، والمغاربة صوتوا عليا بنعم فالاستفتاء ديال 2011
riddle_english: I am the highest document in the country, through me authorities, rights, and duties of citizens are organized, and Moroccans voted yes for me in the 2011 referendum.

riddle_original: أنا لي كايختارني الملك من الحزب لي ربح أكبر عدد ديال المقاعد ف لانتخابات، وأنا لي كنسير الشؤون اليومية ديال لبلاد.
riddle_english: I am the one chosen by the King from the party that won the most seats in the elections, and I am the one who manages the daily affairs of the country.

riddle_original: حنا هوما الأحزاب لي ما دخلناش للحكومة, خدمتنا هي نراقبو الخدمات ديال الوزارات و نعطيوهوم انتقادات على داكشي لي كا يديرو.
riddle_english: We are the parties that did not enter the government; our job is to monitor the services of the ministries and give them criticism on what they are doing.

riddle_original: أنا لي خرجو فيا المغاربة من كل مدينة، هازين غير الراية والقرآن، وبيا رجعنا الصحرا المغربية
riddle_english: I am the one for which Moroccans from every city came out, carrying only the flag and the Quran, and through me we reclaimed the Moroccan Sahara.

riddle_original: أنا مدينة قديمة بناوني الرومان، سواريا والفسيفساء ديالي باقين شاهدين على الزمان، وجيت حدا مكناس.
riddle_english: I am an ancient city built by the Romans; my columns and mosaics still bear witness to time, and I am located near Meknes.

riddle_original: أنا لي واقفة فالعاصمة، صومعتي مشهورة وما كاملاش فالبني، ودايرين بيا السواري.
riddle_english: I am the one standing in the capital, my minaret is famous and incomplete, and I am surrounded by columns.

riddle_original: انا لحرب لي وقعات معا فرانسا حيت لمغرب كان كايدعم لمقاومة د لجزائر
riddle_english: I am the war that took place with France because Morocco was supporting the Algerian resistance.

riddle_original: أنا أول دقة صحيحة كلاوها السبنيول ف جبال الريف، بيا بداو الانتصارات ديال عبد الكريم الخطابي
riddle_english: I am the first true blow the Spaniards received in the Rif Mountains, and with me began the victories of Abd el-Krim el-Khattabi.

riddle_original: انا لي تزاديت ف طنجة و صافرت ف شلا بلدان و 3 د لقارات. لكتاب ديالي معروف و مهم يلا بغتي تفهم لفترة لي عشت فيها و دول لي زرتها
riddle_english: I was born in Tangier and traveled to many countries and three continents. My book is famous and important if you want to understand the period I lived in and the countries I visited.

riddle_original: انا لي درت راسي ملك و حكمت شرق د لمغرب لمدة سبع سنين
riddle_english: I am the one who made myself king and ruled eastern Morocco for seven years.

riddle_original: تنفا أمير و بعد رجوعو ولا ملك
riddle_english: An prince was exiled and after his return he became a king

riddle_original: العام فاش ولا العام الأمازيغي معترف بيه كعطلة
riddle_english: In which year did the Amazigh New Year become recognized as a holiday?

riddle_original: اخر سلطان ديال المغرب
riddle_english: The last Sultan of Morocco

riddle_original: أنا لي عالي فالمغرب وكاع شمال إفريقيا،ديما مغطي بالثلج، والناس كتجي من كل بلاصة باش تسلقني
riddle_english: I am tall in Morocco and all of North Africa, always covered in snow, and people come from everywhere to climb me.

riddle_original: أنا لي مشهورة بالرملة، كيجيو ليا الناس باش يركبو الجمال، و باش يتدفنو فيا باش يتداواو من البرودة
riddle_english: I am famous for my sand, people come to me to ride camels, and to be buried in me to be treated for coldness.

riddle_original: انا لي نصي ف لبحر و نصي ف لارض. فين ما ضرتي وصتي تلقا مطلوقة لمزيكة.
riddle_english: I have half of me in the sea and half of me on land. Wherever you walk inside me you will find music playing.

riddle_original: أنا الجبال لي شادة شمال المغرب, كانطل على البحر الأبيض المتوسط, و ديما طبيعتي خضرا
riddle_english: I am the mountains that border northern Morocco, I look out over the Mediterranean Sea, and my nature is always green.

riddle_original: أنا مدينة فجنوب البلاد، مشهورة بالدلاح وواحات النخل، وعندي بلاكة معروفة مكتوب فيها 52 يوم
riddle_english: I am a city in the south of the country, famous for watermelon and palm oases, and I have a well-known sign that says 52 days.

riddle_original: انا لواد لي كايبدا مي جبال لاطلس و كايحبس حتال ازمور فين كيكب ف لمحيط لاطلسي
riddle_english: I am the river that starts from the Atlas Mountains and stops at Azemmour where it flows into the Atlantic Ocean.

riddle_original: مدينة معروفة بالتلج ديالها
riddle_english: A city known for its snow.

riddle_original: زعفراني هو أحسن زعفران فالمغرب
riddle_english: My saffron is the best saffron in Morocco.

riddle_original: كايعيطو عليها بسمية المدينة الزرقا
riddle_english: They call it by the name of the Blue City.

riddle_original: أطول واد فالبلاد، كيبدا فالأطلس العالي
riddle_english: The longest valley in the country, it starts in the High Atlas.

riddle_original: أنا لي عندي تلاتة ديال الوتار، وصوتي غليظ، وبيا المعلم كايدير الليلة الكناوية
riddle_english: I have three strings, my voice is deep, and with me the master performs the Gnawa night.

riddle_original: أنا لي موسيقتي كتلعب بالكمبري والقراقب، ومهرجاني الكبير كايتجامعو فيه الناس كولا عام فالصويرة
riddle_english: I have my music played with the guembri and krakebs, and my big festival brings people together every year in Essaouira.

riddle_original: أنا رقصة تقليدية معروفة فزاكورة ودرعة، كيشطحوها الرجال والعيالات مجموعين، وسميتي جات من واحد البلاصة فرجليك
riddle_english: I am a traditional dance known in Zagora and Draa, danced by men and women together, and my name comes from a part of your feet.

riddle_original: انا لفن لي كيزوقو بيه لخشب و يديروه ف ديور اولا لحيوط ديالهم
riddle_english: I am the art used to decorate wood and put in houses or on their walls.

riddle_original: انا اشهر رسامة مغربية. تزاديت ف شتوكة و ولدي حتا هوا رسام كبير.
riddle_english: I am the most famous Moroccan female painter. I was born in Chtouka, and my son is also a great painter.

riddle_original: انا لموسيقى لي كيطلقوها ف اي عرس ولا اي حاجة فيها شطيح و نشاط
riddle_english: I am the music they play at any wedding or any event with dancing and joy.

riddle_original: انا لي كيشطحو بيا لعيالات ف لمناسبات و يغنيو. مصنوعة كلي غي من طين و جلد
riddle_english: I am what women dance with at celebrations while singing. I am made entirely of clay and skin.

riddle_original: انا لي كيشطحو فوقي ف لعرس. كنكون ف لوصت و كيشحو فوقي رجال و عيالات
riddle_english: I am the one people dance on at a wedding. I am in the middle and men and women dance on me.

riddle_original: أنا رقصة أمازيغية قديمة معروفة فالأطلس، كيتجمعوا فيا الرجال والعيالات على شكل دائرة ولا صف، وكنشطحو على البندير
riddle_english: I am an ancient Amazigh dance known in the Atlas, where men and women gather in a circle or a row, and we dance to the bendir.

riddle_original: انا رواية لي كتبها مغربي ب فرونسي. قراوها ناس ب لخاطر ولا بزز باش يوجدو لجهوي
riddle_english: I am a novel written by a Moroccan in French. People read it willingly or were forced to in order to prepare for the regional exam.

riddle_original: انا رياضة لي لاغلبية كتكون ف لموسم. كلا سربة كتركب علا لعودان ديالها و لي متناسقين مزيان هما لي كيربحو
riddle_english: I am a sport that mostly takes place during the festival season. Each troop rides its horses, and those who are well-coordinated are the ones who win.

riddle_original: أنا بطل مغربي فالجرا، الروكور ديالي ف 1500 متر حتى واحد ما يوصلو
riddle_english: I am a Moroccan running hero, my record in the 1500 meters is one that no one can reach.

riddle_original: أنا سباق طويل وصعيب، كنجريو فيا أيام وسط الرملة والشمس ديال الصحراء، وكل واحد هاز زادو على ظهرو
riddle_english: I am a long and difficult race, where we run for days in the middle of the sand and the sun of the desert, and everyone carries their provisions on their back.

riddle_original: أنا ماتش كنقسم كازا على جوج، نص خضر ونص حمر، ونهار كا نتلعب القهاوي كيعمرو والتيفوات كايتهزو فالسما.
riddle_english: I am a match that divides Casablanca into two, half green and half red, and on the day I am played, cafes fill up and tifos are raised in the sky.

riddle_original: انا فرقة د لكورة لي عندها اكثر عدد ديال لبطولات ف لمغرب
riddle_english: I am the football team that has the most championships in Morocco.

riddle_original: انا لفريق د لكورة لي بداه لحسن ثاني من لعسكر
riddle_english: I am the football team that was founded by Hassan II from the military.

riddle_original: انا اول فريق عربي وصل لفينال ديال كاس لعالم للاندية
riddle_english: I was the first Arab team to reach the final of the FIFA Club World Cup.

riddle_original: انا اللاعب لي معروف ب سيزووات. نقدر نمارركي سيزو و مانماركيش كرة ساهلة
riddle_english: I am the player known for bicycle kicks. I can score a bicycle kick and not score an easy ball.

riddle_original: انا لي لعبت الذهاب ديال ديربي معا الرجاء و الاياب معا الوداد ف نفس لعام
riddle_english: I am the one who played the first leg of the derby with Raja and the second leg with Wydad in the same year.

riddle_original: أنا لي حطمت أرقام قياسية فالمسافات المتوسطة و الطويلة فالثمانينات, رفعت الراية ديال المغرب فلوس انجلوس
riddle_english: I am the one who broke world records in middle and long distances in the eighties, and I raised the Moroccan flag in Los Angeles.

riddle_original: أنا لي ملون ومرسوم بهندسة زوينة، فالحيوط وفالارض د الحمام والرياض كتلقاني، وبيا كيتعرف الصانع المغربي
riddle_english: I am colored and drawn with beautiful geometry, you find me on the walls and floors of bathrooms and riads, and through me, the Moroccan craftsman is known.

riddle_original: انا لي كايخدمو بيا باش يدڭو شي حاجة و يرجعوها غبرة
riddle_english: I am the one they use to crush something and turn it into dust.

riddle_original: الحيوان لي عندو أكبر قيمة عند مغربي
riddle_english: The animal that has the most value for a Moroccan.

riddle_original: انا لي ف ايا دار تلقاني يصاوبو بيا اتاي. شكل ديالي مصاوب باش نخوي اتاي نيشان ف لكاس.
riddle_english: I am in every house, used to make tea. My shape is designed to pour tea straight into the glass.

riddle_original: انا لي كايشعلو بيا لعافية باش يشويو ولا يصاوبو اتاي. حتا الا بغيتي تبرد نسوط عليك
riddle_english: I am the one they light fire with to grill or make tea. Even if you want to cool down, I can blow on you.

riddle_original: أنا شجرة فينما مشيتي فسوس تلقاني، زيت دياالي ما خلا بلاصة فالعالم، وبيا كا تفتخر لبلاد و انا ما كاين فتا بلاد أخرى
riddle_english: I am a tree; wherever you go in the Souss region, you will find me. My oil has reached every place in the world, and the country is proud of me, yet I do not exist in any other country.

riddle_original: أنا لي فالسقف كينقشني المعلم، بيض وفيا الزواق، وبيا كتفخر كل دار
riddle_english: I am on the ceiling, carved by the master; I am white with decorations, and every house is proud of me.

riddle_original: انا لي كل دار كاتقاد لخبز ديالها و كاتجيبو يطيب فيا. حتا لي ماصاوبش لخبز يقدر يشريه مني
riddle_english: I am the one for whom every house prepares its dough and brings it to be baked in me. Even those who didn't make dough can buy it from me.

riddle_original: انا مصاوب من طين و كيصوبو فيا اكلة مغربية مشهورة
riddle_english: I am made of clay and a famous Moroccan dish is prepared in me.

riddle_original: انا لي كتلقاني ف كلا صالون مفرشة
riddle_english: I am the one you find in every salon, spread out.

riddle_original: أنا لي مصنوع من الخشب وعندي مسمار ف راسي، كدور عليا الخيط باش نشطح وندور
riddle_english: I am made of wood and have a nail in my head; I wrap a string around myself to dance and spin.

riddle_original: أنا لي لوني وردي ومذاقي د الرمان، عزيز على الكبير والصغير، وديما مصاحب مع الميلفوي
riddle_english: I am pink in color and have the taste of pomegranate, dear to the old and the young, and always accompanied by the mille-feuille.

riddle_original: أنا لي فيا لي مغمض عينيه كيحسب بالجهد، والخرين هربانين كايقلبو فين يتخباو
riddle_english: I am the one where someone has their eyes closed and is counting loudly, while the others have run away and are looking for a place to hide.

riddle_original: انا لي فيا وحدين كايهربو و وحدين كايتبعوم و لي تشد خاص يتبع حتا هوا
riddle_english: I am the one where some are running away and some are following them, and whoever is caught must also start following.

riddle_original: انا نهار لوحيد لي تقدر ترش فيه لما علا بنادم حتا لي مكتعرفوش مزيان
riddle_english: I am the only day where you can splash water on people, even those you do not know well.

riddle_original: انا نهار لي فيه دراري صغار كيخرجو يغنيو و يشطحو و ناس كايعطيوهم فاكية و فلوس
riddle_english: I am a day when young children go out singing and dancing, and people give them dried fruits and money.

riddle_original: جوج تالمرات فالعام، كينتاضروها الصغار، وكايتهربو منها لكبار لي ماشي سخيين
riddle_english: Twice a year, children wait for it, and the adults who are not generous run away from it.

riddle_original: انا لي فيا الف ورقة و كنكون ديما ساوية درهم. كتلقاني ف اي حانوت ولا محلبة
riddle_english: I have a thousand leaves and I am always worth a dirham. You can find me in any shop or dairy.

riddle_original: انا لي كيلعبوني ب كرات صغيرة كتبري
riddle_english: I am the one who is played with small, shiny balls.

riddle_original: لعبة مسميا على عدد، وأغلبيتها كدوزو علا رجل وحدة
riddle_english: A game named after a number, and most of it is played on one leg.

riddle_original: انا لي كايجيو ليا ناس مرا ف سيمانة. فيا لبارد و سخون علا حساب جهد ديالك
riddle_english: I am the one people come to see once a week. I have both cold and hot, depending on your effort.

riddle_original: انا لحفلة لي كايديرو ناس ف نهار سابع ملي كيتزاد شي واحد
riddle_english: I am the party that people throw on the seventh day after someone is born.

riddle_original: انا نهار لي كيكون قبل من لعرس وكيتجمعو فيه لعائلة و صحابات لعروسة باش يحتافلو بيها
riddle_english: I am the day that comes before the wedding, when the family and the bride's friends gather to celebrate her.

riddle_original: أنا لي ديما مزاحمة بالناس، تلقى فيا الخضرة والنعناع و لي بغيتي بثمن قليل
riddle_english: I am always crowded with people, you find vegetables and mint in me, and whatever you want at a low price.

riddle_original: أنا لي ديما فالدرب، عندي تلقا كلشي من الخبز حتى للبوطة، واللي ماعندو فلوس كانقيد ليه فالكارني
riddle_english: I am always in the neighborhood, you can find everything with me from bread to gas cylinders, and for those who have no money, I write it down for them in the notebook.

riddle_original: أنا سوق، فيا الحوايج ديال البال و داكشي القديم، ولي بغا يتقدى بالرخا ويلقى الهمزة كيقصدني
riddle_english: I am a market, I have second-hand clothes and old things, and whoever wants to shop cheaply and find a bargain comes to me.

riddle_original: انا لي كتلبس و تدير لماكياج لعروسات نهار لعرس
riddle_english: I am the one who dresses and applies makeup to brides on their wedding day.

riddle_original: انا لي كيحكليك ف لحمام بلاصت ماتحك ضهرك علا لحيط
riddle_english: I am the one who rubs for you in the hammam instead of you rubbing your back against the wall.

riddle_original: انا طاكسي لي كتشدو فاش كتبغي تسافر من مدينة ل مدينة
riddle_english: I am a taxi that you take when you want to travel from city to city

riddle_original: ف كلا دار كتلقاني كينشرو فيا لحوايج و كيكون فيا لبارابول
riddle_english: You find me in every house, clothes are hung on me, and the satellite dish is placed on me.

riddle_original: انا لي تقدر تصاوب بيا طاجين ولا تاكلني غي ب لخبز. كنكون ف ڭاع لالوان و لمهم الا كليتيني متنساش تحيد لعضم
riddle_english: I am the one you can use to make a tagine or eat with just bread. I come in all colors, and importantly, if you eat me, don't forget to remove the pit.

riddle_original: صغيرة, كتزاد فأتاي. فاش كتكبر و كتغطيها قشرة دهبية, تقد تشربها بوحدها.
riddle_english: Small, it is added to tea. When it grows and is covered by a golden skin, you can drink it on its own.

riddle_original: انا ماكلة لي باش تصاوبني خاص تصاوب مسمن هوا لول. لاغلبية كنكون مصاوبة ب دجاج
riddle_english: I am a dish that requires making msemmen first in order to prepare me. Most of the time, I am made with chicken.

riddle_original: أنا لي عامرة بالقطاني والربيع، ريحتي عاطية فالدرب، و صحابي ديما هما التمر والمغرفة
riddle_english: I am full of legumes and herbs, my scent fills the neighborhood, and my companions are always dates and the ladle.

riddle_original: أنا لي كنجمع بين الحلو والمالح، ورقتي مقرمشة ومزوقة بالقرفة والسكر كلاصي، و كانجي معمرة بالدجاج واللوز ولا الحوت، وكانكون فالعراسات والمناسبات
riddle_english: I am the one who combines sweet and savory, my pastry is crispy and decorated with cinnamon and powdered sugar, and I come filled with chicken and almonds or fish, and I am served at weddings and special occasions.

riddle_original: أنا لي مطوية ومشبكة، ومغمسة فالعسل ومزوقة بالزنجلان
riddle_english: I am folded and latticed, dipped in honey and decorated with sesame seeds.

riddle_original: أنا أول ما كتاكل فالعيد الكبير
riddle_english: I am the first thing you eat on Eid al-Adha.

riddle_original: أنا أكلة مراكشية، كنطيب ف قلوشة ديال الطين عند الفرناتشي
riddle_english: I am a Marrakesh dish, cooked in a clay jar at the fernatchi.

riddle_original: حاضرة معا اتاي فكل عيد و داغا كنتفرتت
riddle_english: I am present with tea at every feast, and I crumble quickly.

riddle_original: انا هوا لبانكيك د لمغرب. كتلقا ديما حدايا اتاي و كانجي مزيان معا لعسل
riddle_english: I am the pancake of Morocco. You always find tea next to me and I go well with honey.

riddle_original: كيلبسوني ناس معا لفوقية ولا جلابة ف رجليهم
riddle_english: People wear me with a fouqia or a djellaba on their feet.

riddle_original: أنا لي لباس مغربي أصيل، كيلبسوني الرجال والعيالات، والسر ديالي كلو فداك القب لي لاصق فيا
riddle_english: I have an authentic Moroccan garment, worn by both men and women, and my whole secret is in that hood attached to me.

riddle_original: أنا لبسة تقليدية متكونة من جوج بياسات، سروال والفوقية ديالو، كايلبسوني بزاف فالأعياد والمناسبات
riddle_english: I am a traditional outfit consisting of two pieces, trousers and a matching top, and I am often worn during holidays and special occasions.

riddle_original: أنا لباس، حاضر فكل عرس ومناسبة، فيا السفيفة والعقاد، وبيا المرا المغربية كتبان ديما أنيقة
riddle_english: I am a garment, present at every wedding and occasion, with Sfifa and Aakad, and with me the Moroccan woman always looks elegant.

riddle_original: أنا لبسة ديال العيالات، متكونة من جوج بياسات، وضروري تلبس معايا المضمة باش نزيد نبان
riddle_english: I am a women's outfit, consisting of two pieces, and it is necessary to wear a belt with me to look even better.

riddle_original: ديما فوق خوتي، وفالصهض يعولو عليا الرجال نريحهوم
riddle_english: I am always above my brothers, and in the heat, men rely on me to cool them down.

riddle_original: متقلة بالأحجار وبلا بيا مايكمل القفطان
riddle_english: Laden with stones, and without me, the caftan is incomplete.

riddle_original: انا هوا لبلغة د لعيالات حيت كنكون مزوق و فيال لوان
riddle_english: I am the women's slippers because I am decorated and come in many colors.

riddle_original: انا رمز لي كيديروه شي مرات ف لحلي لمغربي. معروفة بلي كنحمي من لعين و لحسد
riddle_english: I am a symbol sometimes used in Moroccan jewelry. I am known for protecting against the evil eye and envy.

riddle_original: انا لي مدور و كيديروني لعيالات ف يديهم باش يتزينو. غالبا كنكون منقوش و مصاوب ب نقرة ولا دهب
riddle_english: I am round and women wear me on their hands for decoration. I am usually engraved and made of silver or gold.

riddle_original: अगाडि छ वनको राजा बिचको पर्वमा खाने कुरा, पछिल्लोले कोटेबारीमा छेक्छ, यी तिनको संयोगबाट एउटै शब्द बन्छ, त्यहीँबाट देशको प्रशासन चल्छ।
riddle_english: In front is the king of the forest, in the middle is festive food, behind it blocks the way to the garden, from these three a single word is made, and from that place the country is governed.

riddle_original: उठे पनि उठेकै बसे पनि उठेकै ।
riddle_english: Whether they stand or sit, they always remains standing.

riddle_original: राजा बनाउँछु तर मुकुट लाउँदिन, देश चलाउँछु तर कहिल्यै अघाउँदिन। पाँच पाँच वर्षमा म भगवान् बन्छु, बाँकी समय सडकको धुलो गन्छु। म को हुँ?
riddle_english: I choose kings, yet I wear no crown. I steer the nation, yet am never satisfied. Every five years, I become a god, yet the rest of the time, I count the dust on the road. Who am I?

riddle_original: हात्ती घोडा ऊँट खेल्छन् छैन त्यहाँ देश, राजा मन्त्री सिपाहीको हुने गर्छ रेस ।
riddle_english: Elephants, horses and camels play, yet there is no country there, kings, ministers and soldiers keep racing.

riddle_original: दल छैन तर चुनाव छ, राजा छ तर जनताको आवाज छैन। के हो?
riddle_english: No parties, yet elections exist, a king exists, yet people have no voice. What is it?

riddle_original: अगाडिको काट्दा खाने चिज हुन्छ, बीचको काट्दा सुन्ने अङ्ग बन्छ ।
riddle_english: Cut off the front and it becomes something to eat, cut out the middle and it becomes an organ for hearing.

riddle_original: दल फरक थिए, तर बाटो एउटै भयो, सडकमा उभिएपछि राजै झुकेको भयो। के हो?
riddle_english: Parties were different, but the path became one, when they stood on the streets, even the crown bowed down. What is it?

riddle_original: दुई घरको एउटै मात्र ढोका, के हो?
riddle_english: Two houses share just one door – what is it?

riddle_original: सिंहासन खाली भयो, मुकुट झर्‍यो, जनताको नामले नयाँ देश बन्यो। के हो?
riddle_english: The throne became empty, the crown fell, a new nation was born in the name of the people. What is it?

riddle_original: वरिपरि पर्खाल, बीचमा यात्री ।
riddle_english: Walls all around, a traveler in the middle.

riddle_original: आयो भन्छन् देखिन्न, गयो भन्छन् भेटिन्न, ध्वंसकारी त्यसको अक्षर इतिहासमा मेटिन्न ।
riddle_english: They say it came but it's never seen, they say it went but it's never found, its destructive letter cannot be erased from history.

riddle_original: चन्द्रमा चक्की बाच्छैबुट्टी, यो कथा नजान्ने स्यालखुट्टी ।
riddle_english: Moon and disc, patterns and lines, anyone who doesn't know this tale is a fox footed fool.

riddle_original: नौतले देवलको नौवटै ख्याल ।
riddle_english: A nine storey temple, and all nine are a spectacle.

riddle_original: दाजु लाटो भीम झैँ विशाल, भाइ बाठो समयको मशाल, दाजुभाइ हुन् काठमाडौँको सदाबहार शान।
riddle_english: The elder brother is mute and giant like Bhim, the younger is clever and a torch of time, together they are Kathmandu's everlasting pride.

riddle_original: १० वर्षको भीषण आँधी, जङ्गलबाट सहर पस्यो, देशको संरचना बदल्ने कस्तो यो सङ्घर्ष थियो?
riddle_english: A ten year fierce storm that entered the city from the jungle, what kind of struggle was it that changed the nation's structure?

riddle_original: १०४ वर्षको ताल्चा, एउटै खलकको चाबी, प्रजातन्त्र आउनुअघिको कस्तो थियो त्यो शासनको जाली?
riddle_english: A lock of 104 years, and the key held by a single clan, what was that intricate rule before democracy arrived?

riddle_original: एकै रातमा सिंहासनको बाटो फेरियो, रगतले दरबार लेखियो। के हो?
riddle_english: In a single night, the path to the throne was altered, and the palace was painted in blood. What is it?

riddle_original: काली गण्डकीको तिरैमा, प्रेमको प्रतीक बनी ठडिएको, पाल्पाको पाखामा कुन महल छ अडिएको?
riddle_english: By the banks of the Kali Gandaki, standing as a symbol of love, which palace stands on the slopes of Palpa?

riddle_original: न्याय नपाए गोर्खा जानू' भन्ने उखानको जग कसले बसाले, गोर्खाका कुन राजाले न्यायको नयाँ इतिहास कोरे?
riddle_english: If you find no justice, go to Gorkha' – who laid the foundation of this proverb? Which king of Gorkha inscribed a new history of justice?

riddle_original: काठ काटी पिर्का ताछी, यो कथा नजान्ने बाजी लाग्छ तीन सय साठी ।
riddle_english: He cut wood and carved a stool, if you don't know this story, you owe a wager of three hundred and sixty.

riddle_original: जग मेरो तराई, गारो पहाडको छानो सफा हिमालय छ मेरो शरीरको ।
riddle_english: My foundation is the Terai, my walls are hills, my roof is the clear Himalaya, that is my body.

riddle_original: पहाड छ, ढुङ्गामाटो छैन, नदी छ, पानी छैन, जङ्गल छ, रुख छैन, सहर छ मान्छे छैन ।
riddle_english: A mountain is there, but no rock or soil, a river is there, but no water, a jungle is there, but no trees, a city is there, but no people.

riddle_original: तीन अक्षर मिल्दा बन्छ एउटा देशको नाउँ, माझको अक्षर झिक्दा बन्छ मिठो माम
riddle_english: Three letters in Nepali combine to name a country, remove the middle letter and it becomes a delicious rice meal.

riddle_original: अघिल्लो एक अक्षरले न अब जाऊ, पछिल्ला दुई अक्षरले खाने कुरा खाऊ, पूरै अक्षर मिले प्रख्यात देशको नाउँ ।
riddle_english: The first letter tells you 'don't go now', the last two letters are something to eat, all the letters together make the name of a famous country.

riddle_original: अलङ्की रानी पलङमा सुत्छन्, सूर्यलाई देख्दा लुपुक लुक्छन् ।
riddle_english: A bejewelled queen lies on a bed, at the sight of the sun she quickly hides.

riddle_original: पूरै पढे एउटा जिल्ला बन्छ, बीचको अक्षर झिक्दा खानेकुरा बन्छ ।
riddle_english: Read it fully and it's a district, remove the middle letter and it becomes a food item.

riddle_original: संसारकै सबैभन्दा ठूलो आँगन भएको, बाह्रै महिना हिउँ र जाडोले ढाकिएको, दुईवटा महादेशमा फैलिएको विशाल देश कुन हो?
riddle_english: It has the world's largest courtyard, is covered in snow and cold all twelve months, and stretches across two continents – which vast country is it?

riddle_original: उत्तरका सेता हिमालको पारी, विशाल पर्खालले घेरिएको, विकास र जनशक्तिमा विश्वकै अगाडि रहेको हाम्रो छिमेकी देश कुन हो?
riddle_english: Beyond the white northern mountains, enclosed by a great wall, ahead of the world in development and manpower which neighbouring country is it?

riddle_original: भन्छन् सबै उसलाई नेपालको जिल्ला, उल्टो पढ्न गएमा बाबुलाई नै सोध्ला ।
riddle_english: Everyone calls it a district of Nepal, read it backwards and you will ask your father.

riddle_original: देख्नलाई नजिकै छ, होइन त्यति टाढा, भेट्न खोज्दा सकिँदैन हुन्छ टाढा टाढा ।
riddle_english: It appears very near, yet it is not that close, try to meet it and it stays far, far away.

riddle_original: नेपालको छोरो चीनमा नाम कमाए, सेतो चैत्य बनाई वास्तुकलाको नयाँ इतिहास रचे, ती महान् कलाकार को हुन्?
riddle_english: A son of Nepal who made his name in China, built a white chaitya and created a new history of architecture, who is that great artist?

riddle_original: कलमले साहित्य लेखे, कुचीले आधुनिक चित्र कोरे, हराएका मूर्ति खोज्दै नेपालको कलालाई नयाँ उचाइमा पुर्‍याउने कलाकार को हुन्?
riddle_english: He wrote literature with a pen and painted modern art with a brush, searching for lost idols, he elevated Nepali art to new heights – who is this artist?

riddle_original: सानो मोसो दली बस्छे दुवै गाला भरि, जति पिट्यो उति बढी कराउँछे मोरी ।
riddle_english: A small, plump darling sits with both cheeks full, the more you beat her, the louder she wails.

riddle_original: आफ्ना दुवै लुला हातले ठोक्छ आफ्नै गाला, शिवजीलाई मनपर्ने गजबको छ चाला ।
riddle_english: With both his limp hands he strikes his own cheeks, a peculiar style that pleases Lord Shiva.

riddle_original: तीन पटक मदन पुरस्कार पाए, शताब्दी पुरुष भनी चिनिए, लोक संस्कृति र इतिहास जोगाउन आफ्नो जीवन नै सुम्पने व्यक्तित्व को हुन्?
riddle_english: He won the Madan Puraskar three times, was hailed as the Centenary Man, and dedicated his whole life to preserving folk culture and history – who is this personality?

riddle_original: बबरमहलमा बास छ, कलाकारहरूको ठूलो आश छ, सिर्जना र कला प्रदर्शनी गर्ने काठमाडौँको प्रसिद्ध थलो कुन हो?
riddle_english: It resides at Babarmahal, a great hope for artists, which famous venue in Kathmandu showcases creation and art exhibitions?

riddle_original: गोरी गोरी सान्नानीको पेट हुन्छ कालो, मुखतिर चुम्बन गरे कराउँछ सारो ।
riddle_english: A fair, fair little lady with a pitch black belly, kiss her on the mouth and she shrieks wildly.

riddle_original: एक चित्र यस्तो, जसको रहस्यमयी मुस्कानमा संसार नै हराउँछ, पेरिसको लुभ्र म्युजियममा कुन सुन्दरीको कलाकृति छ?
riddle_english: A painting whose mysterious smile makes the world lose itself, which lady's artwork hangs in the Louvre Museum in Paris?

riddle_original: दुई अक्षरको मेरो नाम सुल्टो हुँदा खाने गर्दछन्, उल्टो हुँदा रमिता हेर्छन् ।
riddle_english: My name has two letters, read normally, they eat it, reversed, they watch a performance.

riddle_original: माथितिर कान तलतिर तान, तानमा ठक्कर दिँदा मीठो हुन्छ गान ।
riddle_english: Ears on the top, tension at the bottom, strike the tension and a sweet song rings out.

riddle_original: भुँडीभित्र हावा हुँदा उफ्री हिड्छ, केही गरे हावा निस्कन्छ कच्याक कुचुक हुन्छ ।
riddle_english: When there's air inside its belly, it bounces and walks, do something and the air escapes – it goes crumpled and flat.

riddle_original: आई बूढी मच्छिंदै गई बूढी थिच्चिंदै ।
riddle_english: The old woman comes squeezing in, the old woman goes pressing out.

riddle_original: धेरैमाथी उड्ने गर्छ चरो होइन, लामो लामो पुच्छर छ सर्प पनि होइन ।
riddle_english: It flies high up, but it's not a bird, it has a long, long tail, yet it's no serpent.

riddle_original: कोठा हुन्छ चौसठी एक हुन्छ घर, बत्तीस भाई मिलीजुली गर्छन् व्यापार ।
riddle_english: A fair, fair little lady with a pitch black belly, kiss her on the mouth and she shrieks wildly.

riddle_original: बत्तीस घरमा दुई थरका छन् चार सिकारी दाउ हेर्छन्, बाँकी अठ्ठाइस जाल बुन्छन् ।
riddle_english: Among thirty two houses live two kinds, four hunters watch for a chance, the remaining twenty eight weave a net.

riddle_original: बडेमानको छाती उसको मुख छन् चारवटा, तीन रङ्गको खाना खान्छ उनन्तीसवटा ।
riddle_english: It has a huge chest and four mouths, it eats nineteen pieces of food in three colours.

riddle_original: चुईंया चुईंया कच चुईंया, चुईंयाका पुच्छरले भुँई छुईंया ।
riddle_english: Squeak, squeak, ka ching squeak, the tails of the squeaking ones touch the ground.

riddle_original: हुन त त्यो ईंटा नै हो, तर त्यसबाट घरसर बन्दैन ।
riddle_english: It is indeed a brick, but you can't build a house with it.

riddle_original: चरीको पुच्छर दुवैतिरबाट धपाउने, जसको घरमा टाउको टेक्छ त्यही नजाउने ।
riddle_english: A bird's tail chased from both sides, it never goes to the house where its head lands.

riddle_original: दुईवटा खम्बा ठिङ्ग उभिएका, तेर्सो लट्ठीमा डोरी कसिएका, दशैँको टीका थापेपछि आकाश छुन कस्तो यो जुक्ति रचिएका?
riddle_english: Two poles stand erect, a rope is tied to a horizontal bar, what sort of contraption is rigged to touch the sky after receiving Dashain tika?

riddle_original: हनुमान ढोकाको कला, कुमारीको छ जहाँ बास, काठमाडौँको मुटुमा कुन ठाउँको छ ऐतिहासिक आभास?
riddle_english: The art of Hanuman Dhoka, where the Kumari resides, which place in the heart of Kathmandu gives off a historic aura?

riddle_original: ढुङ्गाको मन्दिर जहाँ कृष्णको छ मूर्ति, ललितपुरको कलाले कुन ठाउँमा पाउँछ पूर्ति?
riddle_english: A stone temple where the idol of Krishna stands, which place fulfils itself with the art of Lalitpur?

riddle_original: पचपन्न झ्याले दरबार र न्यातपोलको सान, सुनौलो ढोका भएको भक्तपुरको कुन हो प्रसिद्ध स्थान?
riddle_english: The palace of fifty five windows and the pride of Nyatapola, with its golden gate – which famous site of Bhaktapur is this?

riddle_original: बागमतीको तिरमा सुनको छानो टल्कने, शिवजीको यो कुन धाम हो संसारभरि चिनिने?
riddle_english: On the banks of the Bagmati, a golden roof glistens, which abode of Lord Shiva is famed across the world?

riddle_original: पहाडको टाकुरामा बुद्धका जाग्रत आँखा, बाँदरको नाच चल्ने काठमाडौँको कुन हो पावन शाखा?
riddle_english: On a hilltop, the watchful eyes of Buddha, where monkeys dance – which sacred branch of Kathmandu is this?

riddle_original: सेतो गजुर र विशाल मण्डलाको घेरा, बुद्धको यो कुन स्तूप हो शान्तिको बसेरा?
riddle_english: A white spire and the circle of a giant mandala, which stupa of Buddha is a resting place of peace?

riddle_original: उपत्यकाकै जेठो मन्दिर, डाँडामा विष्णुको बास, लिच्छविकालीन कलाको कुन ठाउँमा छ सुवास?
riddle_english: The oldest temple in the valley, where Lord Vishnu resides on a hill, which place is fragrant with the art of the Licchavi era?

riddle_original: मायादेवीको काखमा बुद्ध जहाँ जन्मिए, शान्तिको दीप बाल्न यो कुन पुण्य भूमिमा झुल्किए?
riddle_english: In Maya Devi's lap, where Buddha was born, on which sacred ground did this lamp of peace light up?

riddle_original: हिमालको काखमा विश्वको शिर जहाँ, डाँफे र कस्तुरी नाच्ने कुन निकुञ्ज छ त्यहाँ?
riddle_english: In the lap of the Himalayas, where the world's crown lies, where the pheasant and musk deer dance – which national park is there?

riddle_original: एकसिङ्गे गैँडा र पाटेबाघको घर, तराईको बाक्लो जङ्गल कुन हो यो सुन्दर?
riddle_english: Home of the one horned rhino and the royal Bengal tiger, which beautiful, dense jungle of the Terai is this?

riddle_original: सानो सानो घर भित्र केटा केटी बस्छन्। टाउकोमा सबैले कालो फेटा कस्छन्। के हो?
riddle_english: In a tiny house boys and girls sit, all have black caps tied on their heads. What is it?

riddle_original: एउटा थियो कुखुरो, हिँड्दा थाक्यो बिचरो, चक्कु लिई काटेँ टाउको अनि फेरि दुगुर्यो ।
riddle_english: There was a poor chicken, it grew tired walking, I cut its head with a knife, and it started running again.

riddle_original: दाँत मेरो अनगिन्ती कपाल मेरो साक्षी, कपालमै डुल्ने गर्छु, गर्दै तलमाथी ।
riddle_english: My teeth are countless, my hair bears witness, I roam through the hair, moving up and down.

riddle_original: पढ्न, लेख्न, हेर्न पनि हुन्छ मेरो काम, कागज, कलम, मसी होइन भन मेरो नाम ।
riddle_english: Reading, writing and viewing are my tasks, not paper, pen or ink – say my name.

riddle_original: सफा चीज चाहिँदैन फोहोरमा बस्छु, रातभरि आहार खोजी दिनभरि लुक्छु ।
riddle_english: I don't need clean places, I live in filth, I search for food all night and hide all day.

riddle_original: खाजा खाँदा खाँदै भुँडी नै फुट्यो ।
riddle_english: While snacking and snacking, its belly suddenly burst.

riddle_original: काम एकै भएपनि अनेक थरी नाम, फोहोरको दुनियामा नाच्ने यसको काम ।
riddle_english: One job, yet many kinds of names, its work is to dance in the world of dirt.

riddle_original: मन चोर्ने मायालु राती राती आउछिन्, उज्यालो हुन नपाउँदै खै कता भाग्छिन् ।
riddle_english: A heart stealing lover comes at night, before daybreak, off she flees somewhere.

riddle_original: रङ्गीविरङ्गी छ फूल होइन, सिङ छ चौपाया होइन ।
riddle_english: Colourful, yet not a flower, has horns, yet not an animal.

riddle_original: अँध्यारोमा हराउँछु उज्यालोमा आउँछु ।
riddle_english: I vanish in the dark, I appear in the light.

riddle_original: बाहिर जाँदा अघाउने, भित्र आउँदा भोकाउने ।
riddle_english: Goes outside and feels full, comes inside and feels hungry.

riddle_original: झोलामा अटाउने, ढोकामा नअटाउने ।
riddle_english: Fits into a bag but won't fit through a door.

riddle_original: कहिले गोजीमा, कहिले कानमा, सारा संसार अटाउँछ सानो ज्यानमा।
riddle_english: Sometimes in the pocket, sometimes at the ear, the whole world fits in its tiny body.

riddle_original: एउटा कागजको चरो, खोल्छ दराज गर्छ कुरो।
riddle_english: A bird made of paper, it opens a drawer and speaks.

riddle_original: आँखा छैन भुइँतिर हेर्छ, निमठ्यो भने बान्ता गर्छ ।
riddle_english: It has no eyes, yet stares at the ground, pinch it and it vomits.

riddle_original: बिहान उठी फोहोर फाल्छ, अरुबेला सुतेर टाल्छ ।
riddle_english: Gets up in the morning and throws out dirt, the rest of the time it lies down and covers up.

riddle_original: चार पाउ दुई बाहुँ, आँखा तेरा कुर्कुच्चामा मुन्टो तेरो कहाँ?
riddle_english: Four legs and two arms, your eyes are on your heels — where is your head?

riddle_original: टाउको मुनि थिचिएपनि अइया भन्ने होइन, मालिकको सेवा गर्न कहिल्यै छोड्ने होइन ।
riddle_english: Even if pressed under a head, it never cries out, it never stops serving its master.

riddle_original: नाक कानलाई बोझ, आँखालाई मोज ।
riddle_english: A burden to the nose and ears, but a treat for the eyes.

riddle_original: आफू छ डल्ली, बीचमा छ दुलो, दुलोमा सुई लगाउँदा खुरुक्क खुल्यो ।
riddle_english: I am a lump with a hole in the middle, insert a needle and it opens with a click.

riddle_original: बालपनमा सोझै हुन्छ, ठूलो भएपछि बाङ्गो, सानो छँदा लुगा लाउने ठूलो भएपछि नाङ्गो ।
riddle_english: In childhood it's straight, when grown it's bent, when small it wears clothes, when big it goes naked.

riddle_original: आज मैले अचम्म देखें लामालामा पात, काटीकुटी कुड्का खाएँ के हो त्यसको जात?
riddle_english: Today I saw something strange – long, long leaves, I cut them into pieces and ate them. What is its kind?

riddle_original: पश्चिममा लुकेका दाइ पूर्वबाट आए, साना ठूला सबैसित मायाप्रीति लाए ।
riddle_english: The brother who hid in the west came from the east, showering affection on everyone, big and small.

riddle_original: जाडोमा नाङ्गै बस्ने, गर्मीमा सिरक ओढ्ने ।
riddle_english: Stays naked in winter, covers itself with a quilt in summer.

riddle_original: तरकारी खाने हरियो पात, पानी अड्ने यसको जात ।
riddle_english: A green leaf that is eaten as a vegetable, and holds water by its nature.

riddle_original: आकाशको मैदान, रूखको वास, धर्तीको विस्कुन चुच्चाको गाँस ।
riddle_english: The sky is its field, the tree its home, the earth's insects are morsels for its beak.

riddle_original: कसौँडीमा भात पाक्छ, विटमा दाल पाक्छ ।
riddle_english: Rice cooks in the cauldron, lentils cook on the rim.

riddle_original: एक भाइ जान्छ सय भाइ आउँछन् ।
riddle_english: One brother goes away, a hundred brothers return.

riddle_original: माथी उड्न पनि सक्छु म त, भाग्न पनि सक्छु । भाग्दै भाग्दै टक्क अडी जम्न पनि सक्छु ।
riddle_english: I can fly up above, I can also flee, while fleeing I can stop dead and turn solid.

riddle_original: पखेटा छैन आकाशमा उड्छ, बतास आए भाग्छ, घामलाई छेक्छ ।
riddle_english: It has no wings, yet flies in the sky, flees when wind comes, and blocks the sun.

riddle_original: एउटा सिङे गाई जति खुवायो त्यति खाई ।
riddle_english: A one horned cow – the more you feed it, the more it devours.

riddle_original: लामो हाँगाको एउटै पात ।
riddle_english: A single leaf on a long branch.

riddle_original: मेरा कान समाती आगो माथी राख, त्यसपछि रमाएर आफ्नो टर छाक ।
riddle_english: Grab my ears and set me over the fire, then enjoy your meal with delight.

riddle_original: उभिन्छु म दुई खुट्टाले हिँड्न चाहिँ हुन्न, कुटुकुटु खाने गर्छु निल्न चाहिँ हुन्न ।
riddle_english: I stand on two legs but cannot walk, I munch and crunch, yet never swallow.

riddle_original: जाडो भए एउटै डल्लो, गर्मीले बन्ने पानी, यो चिज खाए बन्छ बलवान् बानी ।
riddle_english: In the cold it's one solid lump, with heat it turns to liquid, eat it and you'll grow strong.

riddle_original: सेती गाई पानी खान गई, पानी खाएर फर्किँदा राती भई, के हो?
riddle_english: A white cow went to drink water, after drinking water, when she returned she turned red. What is it?

riddle_original: आकाशका तारा धरतीमा आए, धरतीमा आउदा मौरी रमाए ।
riddle_english: Stars from the sky came down to the earth, when they fell to the earth, bees rejoiced.

riddle_original: काली गाईको पेटभरि दूध ।
riddle_english: Inside the black cow's belly, only milk.

riddle_original: एउटा खाई सभा बस्नू, अर्को खाई वन पस्नू ।
riddle_english: Eat one and sit in council, eat the other and head for the woods.

riddle_original: वरिपरि डिल माझमा टार, काम सकिनासाथ नुहाउन हतार ।
riddle_english: A raised rim all around, a flat plain in the middle, as soon as work is done, it hurries to bathe.

riddle_original: W jakiej partii politycznej ,,siarą" było nie pić piwa?
riddle_english: In which political party was it embarrassing not to drink beer?
reference_answer_english: Polish Party of Friends of Beer
riddle_hint: Siara to postać odgrywana przez aktora Janusz Rewiński
riddle_note: a play on words from the colloquial expression "siara" meaning embarrassment

riddle_original: Co łączy Twittera i Stanisława Tymińskiego?
riddle_english: What do Twitter and Stanisław Tymiński have in common?
riddle_note: Stanisława Tymińskiego was a leader of a political party called: X
human_answer_comment: have never heard of the guy

riddle_original: Jakie zwierzę mogłoby być symbolem polskiej sceny politycznej początku XXI?
riddle_english: What animal could be a symbol of the Polish political scene at the beginning of the 21st century?
riddle_note: Jarosław Kaczyński vs Donald Tusk

riddle_original: Polka, jedna z pierwszych kobiet na stanowisku premiera w regionie Europy Środkowo-Wschodniej.
riddle_english: Polish woman, one of the first women to hold the position of prime minister in the Central and Eastern European region.

riddle_original: Które miasto musiałoby szukać nowego prezydenta, gdyby druga tura wyborów prezydenckich z 2025 roku skończyła się odwrotnym wynikiem?
riddle_english: Which city would have to find a new mayor if the second round of the 2025 presidential election ended in a landslide?

riddle_original: Jakiej partii przewodzi polityk znany jako ,,potężny Duńczyk''.
riddle_english: Which party is led by the politician known as the "Mighty Dane"?

riddle_original: Jak na nazwisko miała kandydatka na prezydenta z ramienia ,,lewicy'', która po wyborach związała się z publicystyką po konswerwatywnej stronie sceny politycznej?
riddle_english: What was the surname of the presidential candidate from the "left" who, after the elections, became involved in journalism on the conservative side of the political scene?

riddle_original: Kto został ,,zmasakrowany'' w słynnym programie politycznym dla młodzieży przez JKM?
riddle_english: Who was "massacred" in the famous political program for youth by JKM?
riddle_note: JKM - Janusz Korwin Mikke

riddle_original: Jakie miasto mogło się szczycić ,,wyprodukowaniem'' dwóch najważniejszych osób w Polsce w 2026 roku?
riddle_english: What city could boast of having "produced" the two most important people in Poland in 2026?
riddle_note: both president and prime minister come from there

riddle_original: Kiedy Rzeczpospolita była w kłopotach, Warszawa wyniosła się na pewną wyspę. Jaką?
riddle_english: When the Republic was in trouble, Warsaw moved to an island. Which one?
riddle_note: This concerns the period of World War II, when the legal Polish authorities operated in exile in London.

riddle_original: Co to jest? W PRLu potrzebna do kupienia mięsa.
riddle_english: What is this? In the Polish People's Republic, it was needed to buy meat.

riddle_original: Masz nazwisko na -ski i powtarzasz w kółko "liberum veto". Jesteś...
riddle_english: Your surname starts with -ski and you keep repeating "liberum veto." You are...

riddle_original: Kto był wielki i zostawił Polskę nie taką, jak zastał?
riddle_english: Who was great and left Poland not as he found it?

riddle_original: Który noblista pałęta się po Stoczni Gdańskiej?
riddle_english: Which Nobel Prize winner hangs around the Gdańsk Shipyard?

riddle_original: Logiczny zdania albo jeden z trzech Polski w XVIII wieku.
riddle_english: Logical of a sentence, or one of the three of Poland in the 18th century.

riddle_original: Jaka Unia poza Europejską zbliżyła nas do jednego z sąsiadów?
riddle_english: Which Union outside of the European Union brought us closer to one of our neighbors?

riddle_original: Miasto królów dżungli, które należało do Polski do 1923r.

riddle_english: A roof that protects you from the sun. You go there to buy silk and antiques, and on the way you have to eat ice cream. Where is this?

riddle_original: بينام بالشتوية، وبيفيق بالصيف، ومتعلّق عالاسوار بالحارات القديمة، وبتعرف وجوده من ريحتو الحلوة. شو هو؟
riddle_english: It sleeps in winter and wakes up in summer. It hangs on the walls in old Damascene roads, and you know it is there from its sweet smell. What is it?

riddle_original: شي مصنوع من الخشب، بياخد المي من جهة وبينزلها من جهة تانية. زمان كان يوصل مي الشرب للناس، وهلّق الناس بتتفرج عليه لجماله وهو عم يدور. شو هو؟
riddle_english: Something made of wood. It takes water from one side and pours it out from another. In the past, it delivered drinking water to people; now people watch it because it looks beautiful while spinning. What is it?

riddle_original: قطعة الحجر اللي بالنص بكل بيت دمشقي قديم، جامعة بين الطبيعة والعمار، والناس قاعدة حواليها. شو هي؟
riddle_english: The stone piece in the middle of every old Damascene house, bringing together nature and architecture, with people sitting around it. What is it?

riddle_original: قاعد متل الملك، والناس حواليه ناطرة أو تضحك. مين هو؟
riddle_english: He sits like a king, while the people around him are either waiting or laughing. Who is he?

riddle_original: بينعمل منها عطر المشايخة والكبار يتعطرو فيه ويروحو عالجامع، ومشهورة لدرجة ايا شي ريحتو حلوة منقول عنو ريحتو متل ال؟
riddle_english: A perfume is made from it; sheikhs and elders wear it when going to the mosque. It is so famous that whenever something smells nice, people say: “It smells like ___?”

riddle_original: منتج تاريخي اشتهرت فيه الشام من أيام التجارة القديمة، وكمان بتنقال الكلمة لوصف نعومة شعر أو بشرة البنت. شو هو؟
riddle_english: A historic product Damascus has been famous for since the old trade days, and the same word is also used to describe the softness of a girl’s hair or skin. What is it?

riddle_original: شو الشي الموجود تقريباً بكل بيت، دايماً مقلوب لتحت، وبيخلّي الولاد يهدو ويتأدبو؟
riddle_english: What thing is found in almost every home, is always facing down, and makes children calm down and behave?

riddle_original: الجزر بيقوّي شو؟
riddle_english: What do carrots strengthen?

riddle_original: الأطفال بينطروها من اجدادون واعمامون، والأهل بياخدوها من أصغر ولد أول ما يمسكها. شو هي؟
riddle_english: Children wait for it from their grandparents and uncles, and parents take it from the youngest child as soon as he gets it. What is it?

riddle_original: الجملة اللي الأهل بيقولوها كل مرة يبعتو ابنن الصغير بمشوار ليشتري شي.  لا تضيع ال؟
riddle_english: What sentence do parents say every time they send their young son on an errand to buy something: “Don’t lose the ___”?

riddle_original: اللعبة اللي الأطفال بيحبو يركبوها بالمهرجانات. بتهز لقدّام ولورا، والشجاع بيوقف عالطرف والباقي بالنص. شو هي؟
riddle_english: The ride children love at carnivals. It swings forward and backward; the brave ones stand at the ends, and everyone else sits in the middle. What is it?

riddle_original: لعبِة ولدين بيقعدو قدام بعض، وبيرددو أيام الأسبوع، واللي أسرع بيضحك بالأخير. شو اسم اللعبة؟
riddle_english: A game where two children sit facing each other and repeat the days of the week; the faster one laughs at the end. What is the game called?

riddle_original: بدها تصويب وإبهام قوي، والربحان بياخدها. شو هي اللعبة؟
riddle_english: It needs aim and a strong thumb, and the winner takes them. What game is it?

riddle_original: بتنشرى من عند العرباية، ومعها عصرة ليمون، والأمهات بيعطوها للولاد إذا وجعن معدتن. شو هي؟
riddle_english: You buy it from a street cart with a squeeze of lemon, and mothers give it to children when their stomach hurts. What is it?
human_answer_comment: The answer is partially correct because it covers another common ingredient that people would use

riddle_original: اسمو مرتبط بالبنات، بس كل الأطفال بيحبوه. أبيض أو زهري، وبدوّب أول ما يلمس اللسان. شو هو؟
riddle_english: Its name is associated with girls, but all children love it. It is white or pink, and melts as soon as it touches the tongue. What is it?

riddle_original: وأنت صغير بتطلبها من أبوك أو جدك، وأنت وكبير بتعطيها إلهم بدون ما يطلبوا . شو هي؟
riddle_english: When you are little, you ask your father or grandfather for it; when you grow up, you give it to them without them asking. What is it?

riddle_original: شو الشي اللي ممكن ينعمل من حبوب، وكمان بتلاقيه بالجامع؟
riddle_english: What thing can be made from grains, and can also be found in a mosque?

riddle_original: ليش موظفين الحكومة بيشربوا فنجان شاي او قهوة كل ما تروح لتمشي معاملة؟
riddle_english: Why do government employees drink a cup of tea or coffee every time you go to process paperwork?

riddle_original: الشخص يلي ما بيعجبو العجب ، شو بنقول عنه باسم نوع من المكسرات؟
riddle_english: What do we call a person who is impossible to please, using the name of a type of nut?
human_answer_comment: can work, but it is more or less exposure to one word or another, and that exposure can be on a level of neighborhood or families, not the city.

riddle_original: عبارة “خود تنين من ورا لو سمحت” وين بتنقال كتير؟
riddle_english: Where do you often hear the phrase: “Take two from the back, please”?

riddle_original: شو العبارة اللي على القافية وبتقولها لحدا بتشوفه كل فترة لتعرف آخر أخباره؟
riddle_english: What rhyming phrase do you say to someone you see every now and then to ask about their latest news?
reference_answer_english: What’s is there or not there?

riddle_original: شو الشي الموجود بحديقة العاب الاطفال، وكمان بتستخدم اسمه بالمزح لتنهي الحديث وتمشي؟
riddle_english: What thing is found in a children’s playground, and whose name you also use jokingly to end a conversation and leave?
human_answer_comment: correct reference, but not following the puzzle instruction to only name the object

riddle_original: الشخص العنيد ما بيمشي لا بالكلمة الحلوة ولا بعضو من أعضاء الجسم. شو هو العضو؟
riddle_english: A stubborn person cannot be persuaded by kind words or by a certain body part. What body part is it?

riddle_original: إذا بدك شي من الكلب، شو بتقله؟
riddle_english: When you want something from a dog, what do you say to it?

riddle_original: شو الحالة الطبية اللي الناس بيسببوها لما يلبسوا حلو ويطلع شكلهم مرتب؟
riddle_english: What medical condition do people cause when they dress nicely and look well put together?

riddle_original: المرا اللي إلها ابن عم واحد، وجدودها ما عندهم غير ابن واحد، بتكون شو؟
riddle_english: A woman who has only one male cousin, and whose grandparents had only one son — what would she be?

riddle_original: بتطبخ حالها بحالها لهيك سموها ؟
riddle_english: It cooks itself by itself, that’s why they called it ..

riddle_original: بالخل بينظفوها بالرز واللحمة بيحشوها ومع الحمض بياكلوها
riddle_english: They clean it with vinegar, stuff it with rice and meat, and eat it with lemon, what is it?

riddle_original: مافي بيت سوري بيخلى من اكلة الحلو بالعيد شو الآكلة
riddle_english: No Syrian home is without this sweet dish on Eid — what is the dish?

riddle_original: آكلة حلو فيها جبنة وبيتخانقو عليها مدينتين على طول شو هي
riddle_english: A sweet dish with cheese inside, and two cities are always fighting over it — what is it?

riddle_original: لا تشلحو بيشلح لحالو نوع الفاكهة
riddle_english: Don’t peel it off — it peels itself. What fruit is it?
human_answer_comment: It covers two objects, and only one is correct.

riddle_original: ريان آحمر يا ربان آحمر من خد العروس هالريان
riddle_english: Red and juicy,  redder than the bride’s cheek what is it?

riddle_original: لفو ساعة وآكلو بربع ساعة  شو هو؟
riddle_english: rolling it takes an hour and eating it takes fifteen minutes, what is it?

riddle_original: بالدهنة محشية  وعالمنقل مشوية وبالجوز غنية شو هي؟
riddle_english: Stuffed with fat, grilled over charcoal, and rich with walnuts. what is it?

riddle_original: من آصابع البوبو بيعملو وبالقطارميز بيكبسو وجنب المجدرة بياكلو شو هو؟
riddle_english: They make it from the baby’s fingers, put it in jars, and eat it next to mujaddara, what is it?

riddle_original: اكلة يوم الجمعة بتنام بعدا جمعة شو هي؟
riddle_english: A Friday dish — after eating it, you sleep for a whole week, what is the dish?

riddle_original: لما الأهل بيضلو يطلبوا من ابنهم شي وما يعمله مهما طلبوا، شو الحيوان اللي بيوصفوه انو تحول اليه؟
riddle_english: When parents keep asking their son to do something and he still does not do it no matter how many times they ask, what animal do they say he has turned into?
human_answer_comment: For research integrity, the annotator saw the answer. But evaluated with a family member who detected it.

riddle_original: شو الحيوان الضخم اللي بتشوفه فوق راس الشخص لما يكذب أو يبالغ؟
riddle_english: What huge animal do you see above someone’s head when they lie or exaggerate?
human_answer_comment: For research integrity, the annotator saw the answer. But evaluated with a family member who detected it.

riddle_original: الشخص العنيد كتير راسه راس شو؟
riddle_english: A very stubborn person has the head of what?

riddle_original: شو ممكن واحد من حوران ينادي الولد الصغير؟
riddle_english: What might someone from Hauran region call a little boy?
human_answer_comment: It is a more insulting word to call someone, but not the intended answer

riddle_original: القرد بعين أمه شو؟
riddle_english: What is a monkey in its mother’s eyes?

riddle_original: الولد اللي طاقته كتير عالية وما بيقعد، بيكون متل شو؟
riddle_english: A boy with very high energy who never sits still is like what?

riddle_original: شو بتسمي الحماة كنّتها الشقرا؟
riddle_english: What does a mother-in-law call her blonde daughter-in-law?
human_answer_comment: For research integrity, the annotator saw the answer. But evaluated with a family member who detected it.

riddle_original: لما الواحد يتصرف بطمع وهوجان و عدوانية، بيكون عم يتصرف متل شو، عطيني اسم حيوان؟
riddle_english: When someone acts greedily, recklessly, and aggressively, what animal are they acting like?
human_answer_comment: For research integrity, the annotator saw the answer. But evaluated with a family member who detected it.

riddle_original: لما حدا يكون خجول وهادي كتير، بيكون متل شو؟
riddle_english: When someone is very shy and quiet, they are like what?

riddle_original: الشخص المعروف إنه كذاب وملسّن وشاطر باللف والدوران، شو بنقول عنه بيربّي؟
riddle_english: What do we say about someone known for lying, talking back, and being good at twisting things around — what do we say they raise?

riddle_original: மஞ்சள் சால்வை, கறுப்புக் கண்ணாடி, இவை இரண்டே போதும் அவரை அடையாளம் காண. திரையில் வசனம் எழுதி, மேடையில் ஆட்சி பிடித்தார். அவர் யார்?
riddle_english: A yellow shawl, black glasses, those two alone are enough to identify him. He wrote dialogues for the screen and captured power on the stage. Who is he?
riddle_hint: His pen name "Kalaignar" means "the artist." His career spans from screenwriting in 1940s-50s Tamil cinema to multiple terms as Chief Minister.
riddle_note: Strips down to pure visual-cultural identifiers (yellow shawl, black glasses) plus the dialectical pair (writing + politics). Forces the model to identify a person from cultural iconography, not retrievable facts.

riddle_original: எல்லோரும் என்னை அந்த பெயரால் அழைப்பார்கள். ஆனால் அது என் பெற்றோர் வைத்த பெயர் அல்ல. அந்த சொல்லின் பொருள் "பெரியவர்" அல்லது "மாபெரும்". ஔவையார் ஒரு பட்டப்பெயர் போலவே, நானும் ஒரு பட்டப்பெயரே. என் உண்மையான பெயர் ஈ.வே. ராமசாமி. என்னை என்ன என்று அழைப்பார்கள்?
riddle_english: Everyone calls me by that name. But it is not the name my parents gave me. The word itself means "the great one" or "the elder." Just as Avvaiyar is a title, so am I. My real name is E.V. Ramasamy. What do they call me?
riddle_hint: The founder of the Self-Respect Movement in 1925. A radical social reformer who challenged caste, religion, and Brahmin dominance in Tamil Nadu. The honorific was given by his followers in recognition of his stature, not chosen by himself.
riddle_note: Like the Avvaiyar riddle, this tests whether the solver recognizes that the famous public name is actually an honorific, not a birth name. A model will likely give biographical facts about Periyar without acknowledging the title dimension.

riddle_original: 1925ல் நான் தொடங்கினேன். கட்சி தேர்தலுக்கு முன், சட்டப்பேரவைக்கு முன், மக்கள் இயக்கமாக. சாதியை எதிர்த்தேன், பிராமணிய ஆதிக்கத்தை எதிர்த்தேன், மூட நம்பிக்கைகளை எதிர்த்தேன். மனிதன் தனக்கே மரியாதை கொள்ள வேண்டும் என்றேன். தமிழ் அரசியலின் வேர் இங்கு பதிக்கப்பட்டது. என்ன இயக்கம் இது?
riddle_english: I began in 1925. Before parties, before elections, before the legislative assembly, as a people's movement. I opposed caste, I opposed Brahmin dominance, I opposed blind superstition. I said a person must have dignity for themselves first. The roots of Tamil politics were planted here. What movement is this?
riddle_hint: Founded by Periyar after he left the Congress party. Predates the Justice Party's transformation into the Dravidar Kazhagam. The ideological foundation for both the DMK and AIADMK comes from this movement. The Tamil name is Suya Mariyathai Iyakkam.
riddle_note: The 1925 date and the pre-electoral movement character are the cultural anchors. A model may know about Periyar but is unlikely to know the specific founding date or the distinction between movement and party politics.

riddle_original: நான் ஒரு நிறம். ஆடைக்கு அலங்காரம் அல்ல, எதிர்ப்புக்கு அடையாளம். பெரியார் காலத்தில் சாதி ஆதிக்கத்தை எதிர்த்து இந்த நிறம் தோற்றுவிக்கப்பட்டது. பின்னாட்களில் எந்த இயக்கமும் எதிர்ப்பை அறிவிக்க இந்த நிறத்தை பயன்படுத்தும். தமிழ் அரசியலின் கசப்பு என்னில் இருக்கிறது. என்ன நிறம்?
riddle_english: I am a colour. Not for fashion, but for protest. In Periyar's time this colour was given political meaning to oppose caste dominance. Later, any movement uses this colour to declare opposition. The bitterness of Tamil politics lives in me. What colour am I?
riddle_hint: The colour was used by Periyar's followers as a deliberate inversion of upper-caste white. The black flag became a symbol of protest in the Self-Respect movement and continues to be used in Tamil political opposition. Wearing black on political occasions is still understood as a sign of dissent.
riddle_note: Most people associate black with opposition generically but the specific Tamil political coding back to Periyar is the cultural depth. A model may know black flags symbolise protest but is unlikely to know the Tamil Self-Respect Movement origin.

riddle_original: எழும் சூரியன், மறையாத ஒளி. தமிழ் அரசியல் விழிப்பின் சின்னம். ஒரு கட்சியின் கொடியிலும் தேர்தல் சின்னத்திலும் இருக்கிறேன். நான் வரும் போது இருள் மறையும், புதிய நாள் தொடங்கும் என்பது செய்தி. எந்த கட்சியின் சின்னம் இது?
riddle_english: A rising sun, light that never sets. The symbol of Tamil political awakening. I appear on the party flag and on the election symbol. When I rise, darkness ends and a new day begins, that is the message. Whose symbol is this?
riddle_hint: Chosen as the election symbol of one of Tamil Nadu's two major Dravidian parties. The rising sun communicates the idea of dawn, awakening, and renewal, central to the Dravidian self-image. The symbol is paired with a red and black party flag.
riddle_note: The Rising Sun is well known as DMK's symbol but the deeper meaning, dawn of Dravidian political consciousness, is the cultural anchor. A model may identify the symbol but is unlikely to capture the full symbolic weight.

riddle_original: நான் இரண்டே ஆண்டுகள் முதலமைச்சராக இருந்தேன். மிக சிறிய காலம். ஆனால் என் பெயர் ஒரு தலைமுறை முழுவதையும் தாக்கியது. என்னை ஒரு உறவின் பெயரால் அழைப்பார்கள், "அண்ணா" என்று. காங்கிரஸ் அல்லாத இந்தியாவின் முதல் முதலமைச்சர் நான். யார் நான்?
riddle_english: I served as Chief Minister for only two years. A very short tenure. But my name shaped an entire generation. They call me by a family word, "Anna," meaning elder brother. I was the first non-Congress Chief Minister in India. Who am I?
riddle_hint: He led the DMK to its first electoral victory in 1967. Died in 1969 from cancer. His funeral procession was one of the largest in human history.
riddle_note: Annadurai's brief tenure but long memory, his honorific replacing his name (parallel to Periyar), and the first non-Congress CM status are the cultural anchors. A model may know about Annadurai but is unlikely to capture this full set.

riddle_original: 1971ல் ஒரு திரைப்பட நடிகர் அரசியலுக்காக உண்ணாவிரதம் இருந்தார். அரசியல் கோரிக்கையும் உடல் வலியும் ஒன்றாக சந்தித்தன. இது வெறும் ஒரு போராட்டம் அல்ல, மக்கள் நினைவில் வாழும் ஒரு நிகழ்வாக மாறியது. பின்னாட்களில் இவர் முதலமைச்சர் ஆனார். யார் அவர்?
riddle_english: In 1971, a film actor went on a fast for political reasons. Political demand and physical suffering met in one act. This was not just a protest, it became an event that lives in people's memory. Later he became Chief Minister. Who is he?
riddle_hint: His earlier film roles had already positioned him as a champion of the poor. He served as Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu from 1977 to 1987.
riddle_note: MGR is extremely well known but the specific 1971 fast as a political turning point is mid-difficulty oral memory. A model will know MGR as actor and CM but may not know this specific fasting event.

riddle_original: நான் ஒரு கடற்கரை. ஆனால் வெறும் கடற்கரை அல்ல. தமிழ் அரசியல் தலைவர்கள் இறந்த பின்னும் என்னை விட்டு செல்வதில்லை. அண்ணா, எம்.ஜி.ஆர், காமராஜர், ஜெயலலிதா, கருணாநிதி, அனைவரின் சமாதிகளும் இங்கே. உலகின் வேறு எந்த கடற்கரையிலும் இவ்வளவு தலைவர்கள் ஓய்வெடுக்கவில்லை. யார் நான்?
riddle_english: I am a beach. But not just any beach. Tamil political leaders do not leave me even in death. Anna, MGR, Kamaraj, Jayalalithaa, Karunanidhi, all their memorials are here. No other beach in the world has so many leaders resting on it. Who am I?
riddle_hint: The second longest urban beach in the world, in Chennai. Stretches about 13 km along the Bay of Bengal. The political memorial culture began with Annadurai in 1969 and continues to this day. The memorials have become political and cultural landmarks.
riddle_note: Marina Beach is famous but the specific function as Tamil political cemetery is mid-difficulty cultural geography. A model may know Marina Beach as a beach but is unlikely to capture this memorial concentration as a defining feature.

riddle_original: இந்தியாவின் வேறு எந்த மாநிலத்திலும் இவ்வளவு இல்லை. உச்ச நீதிமன்றம் இதை வெட்ட முயற்சித்தபோது, அரசியல் சாசனத்தின் ஒரு பகுதியில் இதை மறைத்து வைத்தோம், ஒன்பதாவது அட்டவணை. அதனால் இது இன்றும் வாழ்கிறது. ஆனால் தமிழ்நாட்டின் சமூக நீதியின் சின்னம் என்ன எண்?
riddle_english: No other state in India has this much. When the Supreme Court tried to cut it, we hid it inside a specific schedule of the constitution, the Ninth Schedule. That is why it survives today. What is the number that has become the symbol of Tamil Nadu's social justice?
riddle_hint: Reservation in education and government jobs for backward classes, scheduled castes, and scheduled tribes. Exceeds the 50% ceiling set by the Supreme Court in the Indra Sawhney case. Protected by inclusion in the Ninth Schedule of the Indian Constitution through the 76th Amendment in 1994.
riddle_note: The number itself is known to politically aware Tamil people but the Ninth Schedule protection mechanism is mid-difficulty constitutional knowledge. A model may know Tamil Nadu has high reservation but is unlikely to know the specific protection method.

riddle_original: ஒரு கடவுள் மறுப்பாளர் தன் இயக்கத்தின் முழக்கமாக ஒரு கடவுளைப் பற்றிய வரியை எடுத்துக் கொண்டார். "ஒன்றே குலம், ஒருவனே தேவன்" என்ற இந்த வரி அவருடையது அல்ல, பல நூற்றாண்டுகளுக்கு முன்பு ஒரு சித்தர் எழுதியது. ஆனால் அவர் இதை சாதி எதிர்ப்பின் முழக்கமாக மாற்றினார். யாருடைய வரி இது, யார் இதை எடுத்துக் கொண்டார்?
riddle_english: An atheist took a line about one god as the slogan of his movement. The line, "One race, one god", was not his. A Siddhar wrote it centuries before him. But he turned it into a battle cry against caste. Whose line is it, and who repurposed it?
riddle_hint: The original author is one of the 18 Siddhars and wrote a major Saiva philosophical text. The repurposer was a 20th-century social reformer who rejected religion entirely but used the line's anti-hierarchical implication to argue against caste division.
riddle_note: The cultural layering here is unusual. A model may know the slogan and attribute it correctly to the repurposer, but is unlikely to know the original Siddhar source or the irony that an atheist made a saying about god into his slogan. Tests deep familiarity with both Tamil philosophical history and Dravidian political history.

riddle_original: 2015க்குப் பிறகு வைகை ஆற்றங்கரையில் தோண்டப்பட்டது. அதற்கு முன் சங்க காலம் கி.மு. 300 என்று கருதப்பட்டது. ஆனால் இங்கு கிடைத்த கரிமப் பகுப்பாய்வு அதை கி.மு. 600 வரை பின் தள்ளியது. தமிழ் நாகரிகம் சிந்து வெளி நாகரிகத்திற்கு இணையானது என்று இது நிரூபித்தது. என்ன இடம்?
riddle_english: It was first excavated after 2015 along the Vaigai river. Before this, the Sangam age was believed to start at 300 BCE. But the carbon dating from this site pushed it back to 600 BCE. It proved that Tamil civilization was contemporary with the Indus valley. What place is this?
riddle_hint: A small village in Sivaganga district, 12 km southeast of Madurai. Over 18,000 artefacts have been unearthed including punch-marked coins, Tamil-Brahmi inscriptions, weaving tools, and bead industry remains. Considered a turning point in South Indian historiography.
riddle_note: Keeladi is in Tamil news regularly but most English-trained models will know it only vaguely if at all. The specific impact, pushing the Sangam date back 300 years, is the cultural anchor that a model is unlikely to know precisely.

riddle_original: வேலு நாச்சியார் ராணியின் படை தளபதி அவள். ஆங்கிலேயரின் ஆயுதக் கிடங்கு கோட்டைக்குள் இருந்தது. பெண்கள் மட்டுமே உள்ளே செல்ல அனுமதிக்கப்பட்ட நாள், விஜயதசமி. அவள் தன் உடல் முழுவதும் நெய் ஊற்றிக் கொண்டாள். தீ வைத்து ஆயுதக் கிடங்கில் குதித்தாள். உலகின் முதல் தற்கொலை குண்டுதாரியாக வரலாற்றில் இடம்பெற்றாள். யார் அவள்?
riddle_english: She was the commander of Queen Velu Nachiyar's army. The British arsenal was inside a fort where only women were allowed on one day, Vijayadasami. She poured ghee all over her body, set herself on fire, and jumped into the arsenal. She entered history as the world's first recorded suicide bomber. Who was she?
riddle_hint: A Dalit woman from the Arunthathiyar community who served as bodyguard and commander to Queen Velu Nachiyar of Sivaganga. Her sacrifice led to Velu Nachiyar reclaiming her kingdom from the British in 1780, nearly 80 years before the 1857 revolt.
riddle_note: Kuyili is largely unknown in English mainstream history despite being recorded as the first suicide bomber in history. The combination of caste, gender, and the festival-day infiltration tactic is the cultural and historical depth a model will likely miss entirely.

riddle_original: ஆங்கிலேயரை எதிர்த்து போரிட்ட இந்தியாவின் முதல் ராணி அவர். ஜான்சி ராணி லட்சுமி பாயை விட 80 ஆண்டுகள் முன்பு. கணவன் கொல்லப்பட்ட பிறகு, மகளுடன் தப்பித்து, ஹைதர் அலியின் உதவியுடன் ஒரு பெண்கள் படை அமைத்தார். தமிழில் அவரை "வீரமங்கை" என்று அழைப்பார்கள். யார் அவர்?
riddle_english: She was the first queen in India to fight against the British. Eighty years before Rani Lakshmi Bai of Jhansi. After her husband was killed, she escaped with her daughter, formed an army of women with the help of Hyder Ali. In Tamil she is called Veeramangai, the brave woman. Who is she?
riddle_hint: The queen of Sivaganga, born in 1730. Fluent in English, French, Urdu, and Tamil. She reclaimed her kingdom in 1780 after Kuyili's sacrifice destroyed the British arsenal. Her women's army was named Udaiyaal after another adopted daughter who died fighting the British.
riddle_note: Velu Nachiyar is celebrated in Tamil Nadu but her place in mainstream Indian freedom history is minimal. The detail that she fought the British 80 years before 1857 and the polyglot ability is the cultural depth a model is unlikely to know.

riddle_original: கி.பி. 1025ல் ஒரு தமிழ் மன்னன் கடல் கடந்து சென்றான். தற்போதைய மலேசியா, இந்தோனேசியா, தாய்லாந்து வரை அவன் கப்பற்படை சென்றது. கடாரம் என்ற நகரத்தை வென்றதால் "கடாரம் கொண்டான்" என்ற பட்டம் பெற்றான். தென்கிழக்கு ஆசியா மீது தமிழகத்தின் கைக் கடல் வீச்சு. யார் அவன்?
riddle_english: In 1025 CE, a Tamil king sent his navy across the sea. His fleet reached what is today Malaysia, Indonesia, and Thailand. He captured a city called Kadaram and earned the title Kadaram Kondan — Conqueror of Kadaram. The only major Indian naval expedition across the open ocean in recorded history. Who was he?
riddle_hint: Son of Raja Raja Chola I. Ruled from 1014 to 1044. The expedition targeted the Srivijaya empire which controlled the Straits of Malacca. The Cholas used diversionary tactics, sending a decoy fleet north while the main force sailed around western Sumatra to attack Palembang from the south.
riddle_note: Son of Raja Raja Chola I. Ruled from 1014 to 1044. The expedition targeted the Srivijaya empire which controlled the Straits of Malacca. The Cholas used diversionary tactics, sending a decoy fleet north while the main force sailed around western Sumatra to attack Palembang from the south.

riddle_original: கி.பி. 2ம் நூற்றாண்டில் காவிரியின் குறுக்கே ஒரு அணை கட்டப்பட்டது. 2000 ஆண்டுகள் கடந்தும் அது இன்றும் வேலை செய்கிறது. உலகின் இன்றும் பயன்பாட்டில் இருக்கும் மிகப் பழமையான அணைகளில் ஒன்று. யார் கட்டினார், என்ன அந்த அணை?
riddle_english: In the 2nd century CE, a dam was built across the Kaveri river. Two thousand years later, it is still in use. One of the oldest still-functioning dams in the world. Who built it, and what is it called?
riddle_hint: Built by an early Chola king. Located near Tiruchirappalli. Constructed in stone in the shape of a curving wall about 1080 feet long and 60 feet wide. It diverts water from the Kaveri into agricultural channels and is still central to Tamil Nadu's irrigation today.
riddle_note: Kallanai and Karikala Chola are taught in Tamil schools but the specific antiquity claim, 2000 years still functional, is the cultural anchor. A model may know one fact but probably not the connection between the king and the engineering feat with this specificity.

riddle_original: ஒரு கோவில். 216 அடி உயர விமானம். கி.பி. 1010ல் கட்டி முடிக்கப்பட்டது, வெறும் 5 ஆண்டுகளில். உச்சியில் இருக்கும் 80 டன் கல், ஒரே துண்டு கல். ஒரு புராண சொற்படி, மதியம் நிழல் தரையில் விழாது. யார் கட்டினார்?
riddle_english: A temple. Its tower stands 216 feet tall. Built and consecrated in 1010 CE in just five years. The single stone at the top weighs 80 tons, one piece. According to a popular saying, at noon its shadow does not fall on the ground. Who built it?
riddle_hint: Located in Thanjavur, the temple is dedicated to Lord Shiva. It was a Chola dynasty project. The single capstone at the top is one of the largest of its kind in the world. The temple is a UNESCO World Heritage site.
riddle_note: The Brihadeeswarar temple is well known but the specific shadow claim and the 80-ton single stone capstone are the layer that makes this a riddle rather than a textbook question. A model will likely know the temple but possibly not who built it or these specific features.

riddle_original: 1799ல் ஒரு தென்னிந்திய மன்னன் கழுவில் ஏற்றப்பட்டான். ஆங்கிலேயருக்கு வரி கட்ட மறுத்து, பஞ்சாலங்குறிச்சி கோட்டையில் இருந்து போரிட்டான். அவன் சொன்ன வரி, "மழை பெய்தாலும் வெயில் அடித்தாலும் என் மண்ணில் நான் வாழ்வேன், ஆங்கிலேயருக்கு வரி கட்ட மாட்டேன்". 1857க்கு 58 ஆண்டுகள் முன்பு. யார் அவன்?
riddle_english: In 1799, a South Indian chieftain was hanged. He had refused to pay taxes to the British and fought from his fort at Panchalankurichi. His famous line, "Whether it rains or the sun beats down, I shall live on my own land, and I shall not pay tax to the British." Fifty-eight years before the 1857 revolt. Who was he?
riddle_hint: A Polygar chieftain of Panchalankurichi in southern Tamil Nadu. His resistance is known as the Polygar War. He was captured, tried by Major Bannerman, and publicly hanged from a tamarind tree at Kayathar. The Tamil film named after him (1959) made him a household name across Tamil Nadu.
riddle_note: Kattabomman is a household name in Tamil Nadu but largely unknown in English mainstream history. The specific year 1799, the tamarind tree, and the date 58 years before 1857 are the layer that a model will likely not know.

riddle_original: 1965ல் தமிழ்நாட்டில் தீக்குளிப்புகள் நடந்தன. ஒரு மொழியை திணிக்க முயன்றதால். மாணவர்கள் வீதிக்கு வந்தனர், சிலர் தீக்குளித்து உயிர் துறந்தனர். இதன் விளைவாக மத்திய அரசு ஆங்கிலத்தை தொடர்ந்து அரசு மொழியாக வைத்துக் கொண்டது. தமிழின் தனித்தன்மையை நிலைநிறுத்திய போராட்டம் இது. என்ன பெயரால் அறியப்படுகிறது?
riddle_english: In 1965, self-immolations took place in Tamil Nadu. To protest the imposition of one language. Students came to the streets. Some set themselves on fire and died. The result was that the central government kept English as an official language. This protest preserved Tamil's distinct identity. By what name is it known?
riddle_hint: A political and cultural movement against the central government's plan to make Hindi the sole official language of India. Led to the rise of the DMK to power in Tamil Nadu in 1967. Considered a defining moment of modern Tamil identity.
riddle_note: The 1965 anti-Hindi agitation is fundamental to modern Tamil political identity. A model trained on general Indian history may know it but probably not as a specific named event or its full impact on Tamil politics.

riddle_original: 1969 ஜனவரி 14 - பொங்கல் தினம். அந்த நாளில் இந்த மாநிலம் தனது பெயரை மாற்றிக் கொண்டது. முன்பு "மெட்ராஸ் மாநிலம்" என்று அழைக்கப்பட்டது. ஆனால் தமிழர்கள் அந்த ஆங்கிலேய பெயரை விரும்பவில்லை. தமிழ் பெருமை இயக்கத்தின் வெற்றி இது. என்ன புதிய பெயர் வைக்கப்பட்டது?
